findings: Inspect SDR-only Environment effects and each HDR Viewport; display headroom may be 1 even when output is HDR, so query effective state separately.
Renderer and driver are distinct; Compatibility fallback can remove effects. Forward+ automatic instancing and feature support must be validated on the active rendering method.
Separate steady slow frames, intermittent stalls and loading latency. Controlled workload hypotheses and repeat profiling matter more than optimizing noncritical routines.

Warm caches and repeated timing affect measurements; built-in engine calls retain their cost across scripting languages. Lower physics tick rates trade CPU time for responsiveness and require interpolation assessment.
Test fill-rate hypotheses through controlled resolution changes; merged geometry loses individual culling, transparency incurs overdraw, and material/shader sharing reduces state changes.

Balanced engine algorithms trade throughput for flexibility. Route readers from general measurement principles to CPU, GPU, servers and thread-safety topics rather than claiming universal optimizations.

Forward+ automatically instances shared opaque or alpha-tested mesh/material pairs; alpha blending requires other choices. Combine mesh LOD, visibility ranges, occlusion and light bake decisions according to workload.
Format must be set before instance_count allocation. MultiMesh instances lack individual frustum culling, so partition regions; the page is explicitly outdated and its C# sample omits assigning Mesh.
Active SceneTree mutation is unsafe on workers; deferred changes and unique resource ownership are required. NavigationServer queries allow parallelism while shared AStar objects can corrupt data.
Join every started thread, avoid just-in-time worker creation, protect shared state, and unblock semaphore waiters before joining shutdown; synchronization must not deadlock.

Distinguish shader intermediate baking from hardware pipeline compilation. RD precompilation requires evidence of material/node features; Compatibility needs visible warmup and headless export cannot run the shader baker.

Own and free created RIDs and keep referenced resources alive; avoid overriding node-owned RID behavior. Server getters can synchronize pending work. The GDScript force-integration sample uses an obsolete signature and needs class-binding verification.
Additive blending can amplify above one or invert below zero; choose an additive pose source rather than treating it as ordinary interpolation.
BlendTree creates its final output node automatically; connect the desired final animation chain to it.
Subtracting pose matrices is not equivalent to negative Add2 because multiplication order differs; use Sub2 to cancel reference pose contributions.
Child animation speed can reverse with negative scaling and pause at zero; verify direction and pause on actual tracks.
AudioBusLayout persists bus connections, volumes, bypass, muting and effect ordering; apply through AudioServer rather than inventing methods on this resource.
EQ6 fixes six bands from 32 to 10000 Hz with -60 to +24 dB adjustment; select wider-band alternatives when finer frequency control is required.
Notch filtering attenuates around cutoff while leaving outside frequencies; it differs from band pass and can make frequency space for competing sounds.
The playback meta class is experimental and exposes no own documented configuration; keep ordinary playback recipes on stable stream/player APIs.
Only one CanvasModulate tints a canvas; isolate untinted UI on a CanvasLayer rather than adding competing modulators.
ccubearray is generated by import; disk lossless/lossy compression does not imply GPU compression. This page lists five methods while saying four and needs cautious interpretation of Basis support.
ctexarray files are import outputs; distinguish disk compression from GPU memory savings and verify visible artifacts for texture-array use.
Nested combiners establish Boolean operation groups; moving or generating CSG during gameplay carries CPU costs and should be replaced with meshes for production hot paths.
FABRIK is suited to unconstrained simple chains and preserves prior twist; near-root targets may zig-zag, so evaluate another solver or target constraints.
Use only inside editor plugins because it depends on editor settings; runtime CodeEdit should use another syntax highlighter.
The page has no class description or own methods; do not infer a runtime conversion contract from its name without source and binding verification.
Horizontal child layout reacts to minimum-size changes; let the container own positions instead of manually setting offsets.
Horizontal wrapping is the distinction from HBox; use it for content that must form new rows as width contracts.
The slider is Range based and maps horizontal grabber positions to minimum and maximum; preserve its inherited range limits for settings controls.
Only two children are supported; the draggable divider adjusts their horizontal size relation, so nested splits are needed for more panes.
Baking needs RenderingDevice compute support even in Compatibility, which creates temporary RD; already-baked lightmap rendering does not require that hardware.
Marker2D adds an editor-only position cross to Node2D; gizmo_extents changes the editing hint rather than runtime visuals.
This deprecated wrapper should be replaced by OpenXRExtensionWrapper and registered explicitly; avoid teaching the deprecated class as the current extension entry.
The default profile editor supplies generic editing when no custom interaction profile editor exists; this is editor tooling rather than runtime controller input.
Experimental snapshot query component returns parent entity RIDs by index; retain experimental/runtime support conditions before using it.
Stereo-correct early visibility masking avoids shading fragments hidden by lens distortion; validate on XR hardware rather than inferring desktop savings.
Panel renders its panel StyleBox but is not a layout container; use PanelContainer when child sizing must follow the background.
RenderDataRD is an internal RenderingServer object; never instantiate it from scripts, even though the class reference is public.
Vertical layout automatically responds to child minimum sizes; dynamic content can reflow without manual position recalculation.
Vertical flow wraps at boundaries into further columns, unlike VBox which preserves a single vertical sequence.
Assign a CurveTexture for graph lookups and curve editing; use this resource rather than inventing numeric curve methods on the node.
The graph node emits determinant(x) for a transform; treat it as shader matrix math rather than a scene transform mutation.
Distance fade is a pixel effect based on distance to another object; confirm intended depth and transparency behavior with the chosen material.
Cone velocity belongs in the particle start stage and sets initial movement spread from the center.
Sphere emitter uses inner and outer radii to choose emission positions; it is distinct from initial particle velocity.
The same seed and range produce the same scalar; animated random effects require changing seed input such as time.
World-space normal decoding can support outlines, but availability of the underlying normal buffer must be checked for the renderer.
Vector distance translates to distance(p0,p1) and measures separation between two points; do not substitute length of only one operand.
VectorLen emits length(p0), returning vector magnitude within a graph rather than normalizing direction.
Tracked controllers are registered by the XRInterface in XRServer; ordinary projects consume them through XRController3D.
Rendering overview directs specialized 2D/3D effects elsewhere and gathers renderer, viewport, resolution, stutter, compositor, drawable and HDR topics.
Shader routing separates reference syntax, first examples, visual graphs, compute, screen reading and postprocessing; choose only the relevant path.
Reference separates language/functions/preprocessor from spatial, canvas, particle, sky, fog and texture-blit stages; stage determines built-ins.
First-shader tutorials cover entry-level 2D then 3D examples; they are not comprehensive API contracts and should link to the shading reference.
Audio tasks map separately to bus/effect routing, stream playback, synchronization, capture and text-to-speech.
The vertex-animation series splits shader animation from controlling large instance collections; investigate both for fish-scale instancing tasks.
Separate content Controls from layout Controls and treat theme skinning, focus/navigation and application behavior as different UI decisions.
The inspected gallery distinguishes single-line LineEdit, multiline TextEdit, CodeEdit, lists, graph editor and numeric widgets; use the demo as a control-selection reference.

Routing flows toward buses on the left; renaming bus names breaks stream-player references and falls back to Master. Web Sample playback bypasses bus effects, requiring Stream mode when effects are essential.

Digital amplitude clipping should be checked at Master, effect order matters, and auto-disable stops processing silent buses. Avoid adopting the page's approximate dB loudness language as perceptual calibration.
Prefer HardLimiter as a final clipping safeguard over the legacy Limiter; sidechain compression can duck music for speech. AudioSample playback does not support these bus effects.
Capture and spectrum analysis observe data rather than changing sound; use the spectrum effect instance for queries and validate actual audibility separately.
Choose non-positional, 2D or 3D player based on spatial behavior; Areas can redirect buses and supply reverb. Set Doppler tracking to the same idle/physics update mode as movement.
The page is flagged outdated; Web Sample mode lacks reverb buses and Doppler, and switching to Stream trades latency against effect support.
System-clock timing subtracts initial mix/output latency but drifts on long playback; hardware-clock timing combines playback position and time since mix then subtracts output latency.
Clamp backwards timing jitter only within uninterrupted playback and deliberately reset on seeking/restarting. Buffer reduction can increase CPU and underruns; the tutorial is flagged outdated.
Enable audio input and recording-capable iOS session before recording; fetch the AudioEffectRecord from the Record bus, capture stream and check WAV save errors.
The outdated page uses AudioStreamSample in C# despite modern AudioStreamWAV; verify the current return type and reject empty captures rather than claiming saved audio proves microphone success.
Enable TTS and test nonempty language voice lists before indexing; Linux needs installed speech libraries, and asynchronous speech introduces platform-dependent delay.
Persist user-selected voice and speech rate, revalidate voice availability on a new machine, and do not claim TTS is native screen-reader integration.
GPU blits use a texture_blit shader and optional BlitMaterial, with up to four sources/outputs and no premultiplied-alpha blend mode. Keep mipmaps current after drawing.

Painting must map UI coordinates to texture dimensions; tutorial toggles drawing for every mouse-button event, so production input should inspect button identity and pressed state. GDScript/C# setup signatures differ in the examples and need binding checks.
SubViewport input is not automatic without a direct SubViewportContainer or explicit forwarding; enable audio listeners and choose shared versus own worlds deliberately.

Capture after frame_post_draw avoids empty first-frame textures; select update/clear modes to avoid repeated offscreen work. Compatibility lacks debug draw modes and SubViewport shadows require a nonzero atlas.

The camera section says subviewports capture only descendants while later shared-world behavior allows cameras to see the world; implementation should validate worlds and cull masks rather than rely solely on scene ancestry.
Canvas-item fragment work is limited to the drawn mesh coverage; an outside outline needs expanded geometry. Set exact-named uniforms on ShaderMaterial and retain texture alpha where appropriate.
Vertex offsets are local-space and GPU-only; material inheritance can share effects, so duplicate only when independent state is needed.
Heightmap displacement requires sufficient mesh subdivision and matching normal reconstruction; vertex geometry edits do not automatically update original normals.

Mesh-surface materials affect all shared mesh instances, whereas instance overrides localize appearance. The tutorial mentions get_surface_material for MeshInstance3D and requires exact class verification before copying.
Choose stage-specific shader type and processor functions; spatial/canvas vertex-fragment-light differs from particle start/process, sky and fog stages.

The introduction lists texture_blit but omits its blit processor from the seven-function overview; consult the stage reference for new features. Engine-managed shader programs differ from custom compute GLSL.
Keep UTF-8/LF, tabs, consistent names, uniforms before implementation and documentation comments for inspector hints; preserve project conventions over blind formatting.
Style examples are not compilation evidence: the indentation example assigns vec3 to COLOR and needs semantic correction before becoming a runnable example.
Port entry functions and stage built-ins, map screen coordinates carefully, and supply uniforms for unsupported Shadertoy state instead of assuming its host globals exist.

The generic gl_Position-to-VERTEX mapping obscures clip versus model space; use stage-specific POSITION and transform rules from the matching shader reference. Include files must be gdshaderinc and nesting is limited.
Screen reading uses a back-buffer copy rather than reading the texture being written. In 2D overlapping passes need explicit copy ordering and reads must stay inside copied regions.

3D screen textures capture opaque content before transparents; normal/roughness is Forward+ only. The page's 3D BackBufferCopy warning conflicts with its own single-copy limitation and requires source-backed clarification.

CanvasLayer plus full-rect ColorRect supports simple full-screen effects; chain passes carefully and explicitly establish copy boundaries rather than assuming every screen sampler sees the previous pass.
The tutorial's no-multiple-buffer claim predates compositor/drawable multi-target capabilities. Its third-party hex shader is an example to inspect, not an asset to copy without checking license.
Write clip-space POSITION with near z=1 for the reversed-z path and guard CPU frustum culling independently of GPU vertex displacement.

Depth reconstruction depends on renderer NDC convention, uses inverse projection and homogeneous division, and can only sample the current viewport's depth; Compatibility needs its separate [-1,1] mapping.
Model-space wave/pivot/twist animation and per-instance phase reduce CPU skeletal work, but deformation bounds and lighting normals still need inspection.

The page is outdated and teaches removed color_format/custom_data_format options; modern MultiMesh flags must be checked before allocation. Masking replacement rotations uses interpolation, not multiplication that shrinks geometry.
Particle TRANSFORM/COLOR/CUSTOM persist between frames and can drive a draw mesh while start initializes state and process updates it.
The outdated example lacks a shader-type semicolon and describes start too loosely; validate particle restart/lifetime behavior and visibility bounds rather than promising a complete fish simulation.
Compute requires RenderingDevice, matched buffer layout/set/binding and bounds-safe dispatch sizing; Compatibility and unsupported mobile drivers need a fallback.

Local RD requires explicit submit/sync/readback and manual RID cleanup. Immediate sync serializes CPU/GPU and large dispatches risk timeouts; verify results numerically rather than judging only successful dispatch.
Set initial focus after UI readiness and explicit neighbors for complex navigation; hiding a Control loses focus and UI actions should remain separate from gameplay.
C# GrabFocus.CallDeferred syntax in the sample needs compilation verification; use a verified Callable/deferred method rather than assuming GDScript callable syntax transfers.
A variation inherits its base theme type and overrides selected items; chain related variants to share consistent Button/Label styling.
Only project/default-theme variations appear automatically in inspector selection; locally defined names may need explicit entry and saved readback.
Theme lookup checks local overrides, nearest unbroken Control-theme ancestry, project theme then default, with variation/class inheritance. A non-Control ancestor interrupts propagation.
Focus StyleBoxes overlay normal styles and should preserve readable content; each custom Control must consume theme items and react to theme changes itself.
Anchor fractions reference parent/viewport edges while pixel offsets set actual bounds; equal centered anchors need signed half-size offsets and differing anchors resize with the parent.
The C# TextureRect example loads generic Texture rather than Texture2D, so use version-checked concrete types and do not assume tutorial snippets compile.
Containers own direct-child Control layout and invalidate manual positioning; expand allocates free space while fill determines whether assigned space is occupied.

Nested boxes/grids/margins/splits/scroll/flow containers solve different layout constraints; custom sort logic must filter to Control children and exclude unsuitable children before fit_child_in_rect.
Custom controls need minimum-size behavior, visible focus state, _gui_input handling and redraw on resize/theme/focus notifications.
The page is flagged outdated and C# draw example lacks a semicolon; obsolete modal notifications and type signatures require class/API checks before creating a runnable recipe.
Distinguish continuous jitter, intermittent stalls and input latency before changing settings; physics interpolation smooths tick/refresh mismatch but teleport resets and latency tradeoffs matter.
RD ubershader warmup differs from Compatibility visible-effect warmup. Double buffering needs sustained refresh-rate performance; physics-rate changes can alter multiplayer fairness.
OS-wide statements of stutter-free operation are anecdotal, not acceptance guarantees. Reproduction should log hardware/driver/mode and high-speed input-to-screen footage when latency is disputed.

Design/base size does not change monitor resolution. canvas_items renders at target resolution, viewport scales a base-size buffer, and stretch aspect controls added bars versus expanded visible content.
Use integer scaling for pixel art; independent 3D resolution scaling preserves UI sharpness. Default theme scale is startup-only whereas content_scale_factor supports runtime accessibility scaling.
DPITexture SVG oversampling and dynamic fonts improve crispness but repeated scale changes can cost CPU; platform DPI support and FOV aspect choice need target-specific verification.
CompositorEffect is RD-only and runs on the rendering thread; synchronize mutable shader state, use internal render resolution, bounds-check compute groups and iterate stereo views.

UniformSetCacheRD follows changing buffers, push constants need matching alignment and runtime compilation limits precompilation. Keep engine-managed render data separate from script-created resources.

Tutorial contains inconsistent template_shader/_templateShader and shaderIsDirty/_shaderIsDirty names plus unbalanced C# callback braces; create complete compiled examples rather than copying fragments unmodified.
Use red vertex-color weights to restrict wind displacement and world-space coordinates to align duplicated trees; check deformed bounds and normals.
Separate opaque trunks from leaf materials requiring depth prepass and double-sided rendering; the linked third-party tree is not permission to redistribute its assets.
Fog evaluates intersecting froxels rather than mesh fragments; resolution follows volumetric fog grid and distance, and DENSITY must be written for output.
Negative density subtracts overlapping fog. Verify the documented SDF type against the pinned shader compiler before authoring expressions.
A blit shader uses blit(), up to four source textures and COLOR0 through COLOR3; UV samples the full source texture and FRAGCOORD has a top-left origin.

This reference claims blend_disabled is the default while the drawable-texture tutorial claims blend_mix; explicitly choose the intended blend mode and verify the binding instead of repeating either default.
Save a reusable Theme as an external resource; preview scenes need Control roots and reload after scene edits, with hover and other interaction states checked separately.
Importing theme items can copy values or create empty templates; pinned stylebox editing changes peers, so verify saved resource values and runtime appearance after edits.
VisualShader graphs compile into shader code; inspect generated code and compilation output when graph behavior differs from expected stage semantics.
Implicit vector-to-scalar conversion averages components; use explicit component nodes when that is not intended. Mesh emitters accept saved mesh resources, not imported glTF scenes directly.
Animated displacement needs correspondingly recomputed normals and sufficient mesh tessellation; the four wave amplitudes total one to constrain height.
The stylized Fresnel sqrt expression needs a clamped dot product for robust floating-point inputs; water parameters are an artistic example rather than physically accurate calibration.
A procedural sphere texture uses a 2:1 viewport and spherical UV-to-direction noise to remove seams and polar pinching; save viewport-dependent material local to its scene.
Packing roughness into alpha requires transparent viewport output and explicit blending checks. The source states its noise is MIT licensed, so copied code must retain the actual upstream notice.
Sky shaders can execute background, cubemap, and low-resolution passes; TIME, position, light, uniform, and subpass-resolution changes can force radiance updates.
Read RADIANCE only outside cubemap passes; use realtime processing for continuous updates or cache complex static skies in the cubemap. Half and quarter passes trade fidelity for fragment cost.
Use renderer defines to isolate incompatible shader paths; macro branches are removed before compilation whereas runtime uniform branches retain compiled code and register pressure.

Includes require .gdshaderinc resources, prohibit cycles, and limit nesting to 25; built-in-resource shaders need absolute paths. The include example assigns spatial COLOR, so compile corrected examples instead of copying it.

GPU particle start/process shaders retain particle state across frames and differ from the material that draws each particle; CPU particles support draw shaders but cannot use particle simulation shaders.

Subparticle flags selectively supply initial values; honor RESTART_* for unspecified data and expose CUSTOM through INSTANCE_CUSTOM. Verify the documented AMOUNT_RATIO uint type against the compiler before using fractional ratios.
Reference an existing visual shader parameter by parameter_name to reuse it across stages; the default [None] is not a configured binding.
The visual shader vec4 constant is exposed through a Quaternion property with default (0,0,0,1); treat its components as shader data rather than assuming rotation semantics.
QuadOccluder3D supplies a flat occlusion plane sized in world units; attach through OccluderInstance3D and use PolygonOccluder3D for non-quad silhouettes.
Create nested tween steps only with Tween.tween_subtween(), not manual SubtweenTweener construction; set_delay postpones that step in seconds.
RectangleShape2D.size is full width and height, not half-extents; choose simple collision shapes before considering complex geometry, measuring costs on the actual physics backend.
Bus panning ranges from -1 left to +1 right; positional players already pan automatically, so additional bus panning affects the combined routed signal.
This node generates a sampler2DArray; its TextureLayered property is used only when inherited source selects SOURCE_TEXTURE.

RenderSceneBuffers is an internal per-3D-viewport object and must not be instantiated in scripts; configuration changes discard and recreate internal buffers, invalidating retained buffer assumptions.
Box attractors affect GPU 3D particles only and support runtime nonuniform transforms; size is in 3D units, so diagnose attraction independently of CPU particle simulation.

Experimental XR marker configuration is an on-demand API boundary; enabled components become valid only after the configuration creates a spatial context, requiring an actual compatible XR runtime to verify detection.
Two-finger pan events report the delta since the previous event; Android requires enable_pan_and_scale_gestures before testing gesture-driven scrolling.
GLTFTexture stores sampler and image indices, not direct texture resources; -1 image means absent while -1 sampler chooses linear filtering with repeat wrapping.
MultiMeshInstance3D references a shared MultiMesh resource for many copies of one mesh; isolate resources if edits should not affect multiple instance nodes.
A polyphonic stream permits simultaneous code-controlled substreams in one player; retrieve its playback object only after assigning AudioStreamPolyphonic and respect the configured voice limit.
Deprecated packed-container references wrap nested arrays and dictionaries; new persistence uses var_to_bytes/store_var and explicit byte or file compression instead.
GPU box collision needs rigid or hide-on-contact process-material collision mode; it does not affect CPU particles and unlike attractors does not support nonuniform scaling.
Experimental spatial-query mesh data pairs each indexed entity mesh with its positioning transform; require a compatible OpenXR snapshot result and hardware before claiming scene-mesh support.
GrooveJoint2D restricts linked bodies along its local Y axis; length sets the groove and initial_offset positions body B's initial anchor along that axis.
Experimental spatial bounded-2D query data provides an indexed center pose and rectangle size; preserve that transform when constructing a representation instead of assuming world-axis alignment.

Binding modifiers return runtime-specific packed data compatible with XrBindingModificationBaseHeaderKHR plus an editor description; treat struct layout as an extension ABI requirement, not arbitrary script bytes.

MissingResource preserves unknown resource data when its extension/type is unavailable; it cannot be manually instantiated, and original_class is a clue to repair missing dependencies before editing untyped preserved properties.
A graph color parameter becomes a vec4 uniform; its white default_value has no effect until default_value_enabled is true.
Visual varying names must be unique and varying_type determines stage availability; coordinate setter/getter nodes rather than assuming any stage can access every value.

SceneTreeTimer is a managed one-shot delay processed after frame nodes (or physics nodes when configured); keep an explicit reference only when later inspection is needed and account for ordering in timeout assertions.
ScriptLanguage is an undocumented language-extension base with script-name casing enums; this page provides no execution contract and cannot justify a recipe for adding a language.
Navigation implementation registration occurs at startup server initialization; priority chooses the default, and servers cannot be switched during gameplay.

BlitMaterial defaults to MIX and distinguishes independent-alpha mixing from direct copy DISABLED; this material-level default does not resolve the separate custom texture_blit shader default, so test both resource types explicitly.
Select inverse or transpose explicitly for transform graph operations; neither is a generic interchangeable normal transform, and inverse needs nonsingular input.
BMFont import supports variable glyph dimensions and ordered fallback fonts; compress is lossless, while the scaling_mode enum is not explained here and needs the corresponding font API.

Experimental face modifier maps tracker weights to a target MeshInstance3D by supported blend-shape names; absence of matching shapes or actual tracker data must be distinguished from animation failures.
Transform graph parameters compile to mat4 uniforms; enable the default explicitly and preserve intended transform space when setting the material parameter.
Semaphores start at zero, wait blocks and try_wait reports immediate failure; shutdown must wake and join workers before either thread or semaphore is destroyed.
ReferenceRect visualizes Control extents and is editor-only by default; enable runtime visibility for an intentional diagnostic overlay and account for its border extending inward and outward.

Experimental pipeline shader wrappers select raytracing stages automatically and apply specialization constants during pipeline creation; require feature-capable RenderingDevice rather than claiming general renderer support.
Path3D owns a Curve3D used by child PathFollow3D nodes; start the relative curve near zero and use curve_changed to rebuild dependent state, while black debug color selects the project default.
Convex collision is solid and suitable for dynamic decompositions; primitive shapes are cheaper, and returned points arrays must be assigned back after modification.
Joypad button events distinguish pressed and released using JoyButton indices; deprecated pressure is always zero and must not implement analog trigger logic.
Runtime render models provide the user's actual controller appearance and supported animations; do not infer hardware from simulated interaction profiles, and react to top-level-path changes.
VectorBase is abstract and controls 2D/3D/4D operation dimensions; configure derived nodes consistently with connected ports, leaving MAX as an enum sentinel.
LightOccluder2D needs an OccluderPolygon2D and intersecting light masks to cast shadows; sdf_collision separately includes its polygon in the shader-accessible distance field.
Create method interpolation through Tween.tween_method(); callbacks receive the interpolated value and automatically finish if their target is freed, with delay/ease/transition configurable per step.
Mesh particle emitters use all surfaces by default; disable use_all_surfaces before surface_index selects one emission surface.
Popup is a hidden modal Window by default, not an ordinary Control; show it through Window.popup_* methods and use popup_hide to restore focus or release state.
Mix graph nodes generate mix(a,b,weight); select vector-scalar modes when one scalar weight should affect every component rather than a vector of separate weights.
Socket-stream state updates require poll(); distinguish connecting, connected, error and none, and use concrete TCP/UDS peers instead of constructing the abstract base.
Cubemap arrays require six faces per cube in X+,X-,Y+,Y-,Z+,Z- order; import layout controls layer placement and Compatibility has no supported cubemap-array path.

HardLimiter uses peak prediction and gain reduction; ceiling, pregain and release control clipping protection and recovery, requiring audible and measured mix verification rather than treating limiting as intentional distortion.

Embedding creates only one GodotInstance per process through the C API; the host drives iterations and must honor iteration's quit result plus focus/pause notifications. Embedding is a separate toolchain boundary.

PointLight2D uses a texture for its light shape; height is a pixel-unit normal-mapping parameter while offset and texture_scale affect that texture, so diagnose visual reach independently of shadow masks.

Assign an editor tool subclass as the imported scene's Custom Script; _post_import must return the modified root. Automation must preserve dependencies and prove repeated reimports yield the same intended scene.

Capsule height includes both hemispheres while mid_height excludes them; height/radius setters adjust invalid dimensions, so read back the resulting shape rather than asserting requested dimensions blindly.

MissingNode retains original class and scene plus property/signal data for unknown types; restore the missing extension or scene before manipulating untyped stored values, and do not instantiate it as a placeholder.
Damped springs distinguish target rest_length from length and stiffness; this page's maximum-length claim requires actual backend behavior verification before promising a hard constraint.
Experimental spatial plane semantics classify floor, wall, table or uncategorized per queried entity; do not invent semantics for unknown labels or claim accuracy without runtime testing.
PhysicsMaterial combines friction using rough flags and bounce using absorbent; loss of energy can originate from body damping even at bounce one, so inspect damping modes separately.

BackBufferCopy controls rectangular or viewport screen-texture copies; place responsive Controls as siblings because its Node2D ancestry breaks anchor-based layout. Sampling beyond a selected rectangle needs explicit handling.
Tracked hand positioning needs an XRNode3D ancestor using the same tracker; Skeleton motion_scale scales tracked positions, while rotation-only updates preserve authored bone lengths.
Prism size, upper-edge X displacement and axis-specific edge-loop subdivisions control separate aspects of geometry; increase tessellation only when deformation or silhouette requires it.
GradientTexture1D discretizes a gradient into width samples, so narrow color changes can be lost; use_hdr chooses float rather than clamped 8-bit storage and is separate from display HDR output.
Matrix composition order differs from component multiplication; the subtraction enum descriptions invert their names, so inspect generated code for A_MINUS_B/B_MINUS_A before using them.

Analog XR thresholds use hysteresis: activate at on_threshold and release below off_threshold, with separate haptics; compatible runtime extension support is needed before asserting hardware behavior.
The legacy soft-clip limiter is deprecated in favor of HardLimiter and soft_clip_ratio has no effect; migration must retune the actual signal rather than copying ineffective properties.

Mutable bone axes follow pose changes each frame; cached rest axes improve cost but ignore preceding positional pose edits, so choose based on modifier ordering and reset state when changing pose assumptions.

Recording captures bus output into AudioStreamWAV with encoded format; microphone input additionally needs project input enablement and permissions, and restarting recording destroys the previous sample.
Experimental plane capabilities expose labels/mesh/polygon support only after XR session startup; enabled-components queries additionally require creating the context with that configuration.

EditorScript requires tool mode and _run(), with named classes available in the command palette; asynchronous work needs a retained reference and current EditorInterface singleton replaces deprecated helper methods.

RenderSceneBuffersExtension is a GDExtension implementation hook for viewport resize and filtering/upscale/debanding changes; it is an internal rendering boundary, not an ordinary game-script compositor recipe.
Phaser uses six all-pass stages and an LFO to produce spectral notches/peaks; feedback sharpens and raises peaks, so audition rate/range/depth with output-level checks.
Procedural occluders use local vertices and indices; set_arrays updates once instead of rebuilding after each property setter, and returned arrays are copies requiring reassignment.
RD texture views can override only formats declared shareable by the source texture format; swizzles change sampled channels and DATA_FORMAT_MAX preserves the original format.
RootMotionView visualizes an AnimationMixer's motion only in the editor; its grid/zero_y options do not move runtime characters, which must apply extracted root motion separately.
Spatial configuration wrappers expose int64-encoded native pointers intended for GDExtensions; struct memory must outlive the wrapper and validity must be checked before context creation.
Experimental equirectangular XR layers render a SubViewport on the sphere interior; horizontal/vertical angles and radius size the layer while fallback_segments changes fallback mesh fidelity.
XR action sets activate related inputs together for modes such as menus/vehicles; when same-name actions overlap, higher set priority determines the active binding, requiring transition tests.
TriangleMesh builds a BVH from triangle triplets for physicsless ray/segment picking; creation can be expensive, return success must be checked and no hit is an empty dictionary.
Marker IDs apply to Aruco/AprilTag while QR markers expose string or bytes data; only discovery logic should set marker data, and tracking remains experimental hardware-dependent scope.
Spatial query component extensions must allocate buffers to requested capacity and keep native structure pointers valid for object lifetime; pointer wrappers demand ABI verification.

Mouse position coordinates differ by callback: _gui_input is Control-local while _input is viewport-local; global_position is CanvasLayer-local in GUI callbacks, so transform deliberately when dragging across layers.

Joint nodes must reference PhysicsBody3D nodes and exclude pairwise collisions by default; a single linked body attaches to a fixed body, while solver_priority affects GodotPhysics but is ignored by Jolt.

Render-model manager adds/removes models with runtime device activation; tracker filters and pose-local containers control presentation, and removal signals require releasing references before deletion.
XR future completed signals also fire for cancellation, so inspect status before interpreting the function-specific result; only the implementing extension should set result values.

TCP connect initiates a socket lifecycle whose current state must be polled; bind is for explicit source interfaces, and no_delay trades small-message latency against bulk-transfer efficiency. Android needs INTERNET permission.
3D point queries use global coordinates, detect bodies by default but not areas, and exclude object RIDs; modify-and-reassign copied exclusion arrays before querying.
Register tooltip plugins with FileSystemDock and preserve the provided base control or free it explicitly; asynchronous thumbnails avoid blocking resource loads during hover.

Plane discovery callbacks usually run before and after processing, but errors skip the second call; only the processed callback guarantees valid component data, so use future status to handle failures.

Fog volumes need enabled environment volumetric fog; zero global density leaves local volumes, negative density subtracts fog, and thin-volume flicker can be traded against grid depth, range or thickness.

Soft-body rendering handlers update bounds and indexed normals/vertices for physics-server extensions; current Vector3 bindings replace pre-4.2 void pointers, and implementing a physics backend is a separate native scope.
Camera attributes on Camera3D override WorldEnvironment defaults while GI consumers use exposure only; auto-exposure needs Forward+, and ISO sensitivity needs physical light units.

Collision polygons extrude local XY vertices into a prism for a CollisionObject3D parent; change disabled deferred, reassign edited vertex arrays and verify depth bounds rather than assuming the prose specifies half/full extent unambiguously.

Expression parsing and execution have separate failures; bind input values in parsed-name order and check has_execute_failed before consuming results, especially when supplying a callable base instance.

Stretch owns child viewport sizes and stretch_shrink reduces internal resolution while preserving displayed size; mouse_target determines drag/cursor targeting, and optional propagation filters need input lifecycle tests.

Ribbon trails use sections and section_segments for length/tessellation, with width curve multiplying baseline size; negative curve values invert faces, so validate curve range and particle-trail rendering.
2D point queries default to the viewport's default canvas rather than all layers; choose canvas_instance_id, global point, mask and body/area filters explicitly, and reassign exclusions after edits.

DTLS wraps an already connected UDP peer and needs frequent polling through handshake and connected states; hostname mismatch is distinct, and this implementation does not support certificate revocation or pinning.
GridMap editor selection bounds use cell coordinates; palette item indices can differ from UI order and -1 means no selection, so tools must query the current map/selection before editing.

ZIPReader opens an archive index and reads whole files into memory; its extract-all sample omits error handling and path-containment checks, so original import recipes must validate entries, write failures and close resources.

Shader frames group and move attached nodes for organization; modify membership through VisualShader.attach_node_to_frame/detach_node_from_frame rather than direct frame helpers, and reassign copied ID arrays.

Text-server switching invalidates fonts and shaped buffers; unload Controls/fonts/themes before changing or removing an interface and rebuild caches afterward, rather than hot-swapping under existing UI.

Sprite3D supports atlas regions or sheet frames; changing row/column counts preserves the visual cell when possible and resets otherwise, while material_override replaces displayed texture but still uses its dimensions.

Navigation query paths use global coordinates and can carry region/link types, RIDs and owner IDs per point; reset reusable results to avoid stale query data and request needed metadata explicitly in parameters.

Pipeline sample shading increases fragment work beyond ordinary MSAA and coverage uses the first color alpha; the min_sample_shading prose compares a bool property to 1.0, so verify exact Vulkan semantics instead of copying that condition.

PhysicalBone2D requires a skeleton physical-bones modification for visible bones to follow physics and manual Joint2D children for connections; query actual simulation state separately from the requested flag.

PackedScene.pack serializes owned descendants and replaces previous packed data; save then reload and instantiate to prove dynamically added children persisted. Editor edit-state flags are unavailable in runtime builds.

Float graph parameters expose Inspector range/step hints, not a guaranteed runtime clamp; default values require enabling and this page swaps min/max prose, so verify generated hints by name and value.

Distortion remains active at drive zero, and overdrive ignores drive entirely; disable the effect for bypass, use pre_gain to change shaping and post_gain to change output loudness without altering waveform.

Spot angle is angular radius and range is independent of node scale; Mobile/Compatibility per-object light limits and undeformed AABBs can cause disappearing lighting, so inspect bounds and overlap before increasing energy.

Preview generators always run in worker threads and may return null for fallback; generate metadata for tooltip reuse and use request_draw_and_wait for server drawing rather than unsafe active scene-tree operations.

MP3 beat_count can end looping/interactive playback before physical file end; runtime loading reads whole data into memory and needs null/error handling. MP1/MP2 support is an optional custom engine build flag.

Deprecated OpenXRHand mixes hand positioning and skeleton updates; migrate to XRHandModifier3D with tracker-driven ancestors, retaining rotation-only behavior when modeled bone lengths must remain intact.

ScrollBar custom_step changes button/key increments independently of Range.step; theme both grabber and arrow hover/pressed states plus focused scroll background, using a concrete horizontal/vertical subclass.

Debugger sessions come from EditorDebuggerPlugin and cannot be instantiated directly; active, broken and debuggable are separate states, so tab/profiler/message tools must handle remote stop and restart.
GLTFBufferView identifies a byte slice using buffer index, offset and length; load_buffer_view_data does not support interleaved stride, so check byte_stride before using it for custom decoding.
Touch aiming should use unscaled screen_relative/screen_velocity to avoid stretch-dependent sensitivity; index identifies the touch and pen pressure/tilt availability needs real device checks.
2D ray endpoints are global coordinates; inside hits return zero normals when enabled and concave shapes ignore that option, so robust hit handling cannot normalize every returned normal.
Vorbis runtime loaders require actual Vorbis data and beat metadata governs interactive/loop endpoints; tags are optional with no guaranteed date format, so UI metadata must provide fallbacks.

GLTF skeleton bone-to-node mappings are export-only and unused during import; most methods here are undocumented, so preserve an on-demand source boundary rather than inventing import-retarget semantics.
Comparison output is a scalar boolean; vector conditions reduce component tests with ALL or ANY.

Ordering operators are invalid for boolean and transform inputs; condition prose mentions only Vector3 despite enums also offering Vector2 and Vector4, so generated behavior needs verification before imposing that restriction.
Texture3D is an abstract base; use concrete image, compressed, noise or rendering-device textures, and keep all Z slices consistent in dimensions and mipmap count.
Custom implementations supply data, dimensions, format and mipmap virtuals. The get_height prose calls its Y dimension Width, a documentation typo rather than an alternate dimension convention.
Check start errors and distinguish execution is_alive from is_started, which remains true until joined; wait_to_finish returns the Callable result and must precede releasing the containing instance.

Shutdown requires no held mutex or semaphore wait and a completed join. Disabling per-thread safety checks transfers responsibility to the caller; worker pool restores checks after tasks and node group processing is a distinct mechanism.
Movement collision data separates traveled motion from remaining motion, enabling a custom response rather than discarding the remainder.

Contact position is global; identify the collider object, physics RID and shape index separately, and use collider velocity for moving-body responses. The angle is always positive relative to the supplied up direction.
ResourceSaver.save takes resource before path, selects a registered format saver, returns an Error, and uses resource_path only when path is empty; reload saved content to validate persistence.

Compression applies only to binary resources; CHANGE_PATH and REPLACE_SUBRESOURCE_PATHS alter resource identities. Generated UIDs are not persisted during game runtime, so runtime saves cannot depend on editor UID generation.
FlowContainer wraps controls into rows or columns; distinguish general alignment from the final partially filled line alignment, and measure line count after layout.
Orientation is fixed on HFlowContainer/VFlowContainer; reverse_fill reverses cross-axis line order, with vertical RTL reversing that direction again. Separation belongs to theme constants.
The generator and its all-in-one bake API are deprecated. Migration separates main-thread SceneTree parsing into NavigationMeshSourceGeometryData3D from expensive geometry-data baking.

Mesh source readback can stall RenderingServer; use collision geometry or authored arrays where suitable, balancing object count and complexity. Meshes have no solid-inside concept, so enclosed obstacle interiors can receive walkable polygons.
AimModifier3D is the simple bone-reference aiming option without LookAtModifier angle limits or temporal interpolation; non-Euler mode uses a forward-to-reference rotation arc.
Relative mode composes against current pose; disabling it replaces that pose relative to rest. Primary and secondary rotation-axis settings only affect Euler mode.
Delay separates original dry signal, two independently enabled taps and optional repeating feedback; tap delay and pan can create discrete stereo echoes, unlike diffuse reverb.
Tap and feedback levels use dB, delay uses milliseconds and feedback lowpass uses Hz; tune feedback decay separately from dry volume and verify audibly on the target output.

RetargetModifier transfers parent rest-relative poses to child skeletons during the parent update, overwriting normal-process mapped target poses; subsequent target adjustment belongs in a target SkeletonModifier child.

Local-pose mode accommodates different proportions and independent transform flags. Global-pose mode accounts for missing intermediary bones but requires matching lengths and may distort unmapped parents with mapped children.
Loading distinguishes missing dependencies, already loaded, not loaded and needs-restart statuses; confirm loaded state and extension instance after handling the status.

Reload is editor-only and always fails in release builds; loading/unloading notifications are editor-build signals. load_extension_from_function accepts a native initialization pointer and unique libgodot:// identifier, not an ordinary GDScript callable.
FloatFunc maps one scalar input to a selected shader function, defaults to sign, and provides saturation, reciprocal and angle-unit conversion without inventing separate graph-node APIs.

The roundEven description says nearest even integer, which is too broad: verify shader-function rounding semantics at halfway values rather than claiming all outputs are even integers. Mathematical domains such as logarithm and reciprocal need guarded input.

AnimatedTexture is explicitly deprecated as malfunctioning in current versions with no equivalent texture-resource workaround; prefer a task-specific node animation approach rather than promising a drop-in replacement.

Its legacy contract limits frames to 256, excludes AtlasTexture and crops differing texture sizes; zero-duration frames skip, selecting current_frame resets timing, and one-shot completion does not set pause.
Obtain direct_space_state from World2D rather than constructing it. cast_motion returns safe/unsafe motion fractions and ignores pre-existing overlaps, which require collide_shape checks.

collide_shape produces contact-point pairs, intersect_shape produces collider dictionaries and rest_info chooses the nearest contact with Area2D velocity zero. Point queries exclude non-solid segment/concave polygons; a ray starting inside can yield a zero normal when configured to hit from inside.
Request transitions through AnimationTree parameter paths; transition_request clears on the next process frame, and current_state/index change at fade start rather than fade completion.

Use unit curves for easing and seconds for xfade; auto-advance wraps last input to first, reset governs restart, and self-transition requires its explicit flag. Crossfade time is not scaled by downstream delta.
World3D provides this state. Shape overlap, rest and intersect queries ignore motion, while cast_motion returns safe/unsafe travel fractions and ignores initial overlaps.

Ray results include face_index only for ConcavePolygonShape3D, otherwise -1; configured hits from inside return zero normals. Contact-point pair arrays differ from collider dictionaries and nearest rest-info results.
Explicitly open MIDI inputs, inspect connected inputs and close them; only input is supported and Web requires permission from the open call.

Normalize NOTE_ON with velocity zero to release behavior; channels and instruments use zero-based numbering, with percussion channel 9. Pressure may remain zero on hardware, so device tests must distinguish unavailable pressure from silence.
Traverse file/subdirectory counts with indexed access and handle -1 name lookups and null root parents; resource type is a class name rather than a filename extension.
Import-valid state and script class_name/base metadata support editor diagnostics, but empty script metadata means no class_name declaration, not necessarily a malformed script.
The modifier compares consecutive poses and caps angular velocity per second on chain-derived bone lists; exclude flips the selected set rather than disabling the modifier.

Chain end must equal or descend from its root. reset establishes an unconstrained current reference pose and is automatic on activation/joint changes, so discontinuous pose changes require testing reset behavior.
Experimental FABRIK maintains chain lengths through forward/backward passes toward a target; modification joint records are distinct from Bone2D nodes and must be mapped by index or NodePath.
Magnets bias the solution before solving. Target rotation only applies to the terminal joint and is ignored elsewhere, so configure and verify the tip separately from chain reaching.
BitMap stores one-bit occupancy; alpha conversion marks true only above the threshold and converts back to L8 black/white, so it does not retain source color or alpha precision.

grow_mask dilates with positive pixels and erodes with negative pixels only inside the supplied rectangle. Polygon extraction uses marching squares plus RDP, trading lower epsilon for more vertices; use the declared Rect2i signature rather than the old Rect2 sample.
Prefer queued DNS resolution when main-thread blocking is unacceptable; check invalid queue ID and waiting/done/error status before interpreting empty address results.
Erase completed queue items to release the bounded 256 slots. Cache clearing differs from query cleanup, and local interfaces include multiple IPv4/IPv6 addresses with possibly empty friendly names.
Rich-text effects operate on shaped glyphs: font RID and cluster metadata are read-only even though setter signatures exist, while replacement glyph_index must come from the current font.

visible=false reflows surrounding characters; transparent color preserves spacing. Effect time resets on text edits and pauses with process mode but continues while hidden. BBCode env strings cannot contain spaces even when quoted.

Menu slot determines popup inputs and callback payloads; scene paths become nodes, script paths become script references, inspector popup supplies ID/property but callback supplies EditorProperty. Generic Array callback prose conflicts with some slot-specific singular payloads, requiring binding/runtime verification.

Register shortcuts once before attaching shortcut menu items. Submenus need manual signal connections and a new PopupMenu for each popup because the editor frees them. Description claims three areas but enum exposes eight slots, so use the pinned slot definitions.
3D movement can report multiple indexed collisions, with index zero selecting the deepest by default; iterate get_collision_count rather than assuming a single collider.

Global contact position, normal and collider velocity are per-contact, while travel, remainder and depth are movement-level values without collision indices; preserve that distinction in custom response diagnostics.

Populate the owned PopupMenu through get_popup, refresh options with about_to_popup and use show_popup to obtain button-relative placement and sizing. Never remove or free this required internal node.
Dynamic item properties use zero-based indices, distinct from item IDs; hover switching requires sibling MenuButtons with the option enabled on both, while shortcut disabling affects activation.
Initialize DrawableTexture2D before experimental blits; target rectangle, optional mip level and TextureBlit ShaderMaterial control GPU-side drawing, and mipmaps regenerate explicitly.

Multi-blit accepts at most four sources and three extra targets; all targets must match size/format and missing sources become black. setup signature accepts a color despite prose only describing white, so verify initialization color rather than hardcoding the prose.
Formats distinguish 8-bit sRGB conversion from half/full float storage; float storage alone does not enable display HDR.
Use concrete HSlider/VSlider and inherited Range constraints; editable=false blocks interaction but allows programmatic updates, while scrollable independently enables wheel changes.

drag_started precedes value_changed and drag_ended reports whether final value differs from initial; ticks are visual markers, not snapping constraints. Theme icons/styles govern focused, disabled and grabber geometry states.
RDShaderSource supplies textual per-stage source to RenderingDevice and is distinct from high-level Godot Shader resources consumed by scene nodes.

When setting raw compute source directly, remove the Godot #[compute] import hint. Additional ray-tracing stages appear in properties despite older get/set prose listing only raster/compute stages; availability still requires device/backend capability checks.

Obstacle baking subtraction requires affect_navigation_mesh and inclusion in parsing; carve bypasses agent-radius offsets but not later simplification. Avoidance is a separate enabled operation using layer/mask matches.

Clockwise outlines push agents inward and counterclockwise outward; crossed/overlapping outlines are invalid. Static vertex movement rebuilds avoidance maps and can trap agents, while velocity prediction applies only to radius-based avoidance.
Use the node set_navigation_map method to synchronize node and server state; direct server mutation leaves the node map getter stale. Retrieved vertices are copies and must be reassigned after edits.
Set pixel patch margins relative to the selected atlas region; empty region samples the full texture. draw_center can leave only borders and nonuniform margins support asymmetric panels.

Choose stretch, seamless tile or tile-fit independently per axis; defaults are stretch despite introduction describing tiling. Tile-fit stretches full tiles slightly and must be visually checked at multiple panel sizes.

RenderingDevice samplers specify independent minification, magnification, mip filtering and axis repeat modes; normalized coordinates use 0..1 while unnormalized coordinates address texture resolution.
Anisotropy requires use_anisotropy and a maximum above one, is hardware-limited and consumes bandwidth. Compare sampling requires enable_compare; mip bias and min/max LOD require actual mipmaps.
Border-color prose groups all disabled repeat modes together; verify clamp-to-border versus clamp-to-edge enum behavior before promising that every out-of-range nonrepeat sample returns border color.
OneShot requests FIRE, ABORT and FADE_OUT are transient AnimationTree parameters clearing on next process; read active/internal_active rather than using retained request as state.

Autorestart begins only after FIRE; ABORT stops the sequence without clearing the autorestart setting, so another FIRE restarts it. Random delay adds to base delay, and break_loop_at_end permits looping input completion.

Fade-in/out use unit curves and occur at animation boundaries; documented state transitions occur after fade completes, unlike AnimationNodeTransition. Distinguish blend versus additive mixing and reset-abort behavior.
Programmatic value changes emit value_changed; use set_value_no_signal for UI reflection and debounce expensive continuous slider work. changed tracks limits/page/step rather than value.

Step quantization is relative to min_value, followed by integer rounding when enabled; allow_greater/lesser relax bounds, exponential ratio requires nonnegative minimum. Sharing binds entire Range state across groups, not merely values.

UDP connect_to_host filters source/destination endpoints without handshake or authentication; it sends no packet and prevents subsequent destination changes, so socket-connected state does not prove remote availability.

Read sender IP/port after receiving each packet. Check bind/destination/send errors; Android needs INTERNET and may need multicast-state permission for group/broadcast traffic, with broadcast sending enabled explicitly.

wait is uninterruptible once called; prefer polling for responsive shutdown or a controlled local wakeup packet with validated payload/source. Documentation examples omit bind/error checks and C# Error.OK qualification, so they are not complete lifecycle recipes.
Links contribute off-surface routing between endpoints on the same or different regions; they describe route connectivity, while jumping/teleport traversal behavior still needs game logic.

Endpoints are local to the link with explicit global setters; attachment searches nearby polygons within the map link-connection radius. Verify map, navigation-layer match, enabled state and direction when a cross-region path fails.

enter_cost adds a fixed entry cost while travel_cost multiplies link distance. Default map follows World2D unless explicitly overridden; layer helper numbering is 1..32 rather than zero-based bit indices.
Compile a PCRE2 pattern and check Error or is_valid before search; account for GDScript string escaping or use raw strings, and handle null/empty matches explicitly.
Search offsets limit the region without rebasing anchors or preceding word-boundary context; search_all returns non-overlapping results and duplicate named groups resolve the first matched group.
Replacement expands dollar backreferences and replaces only the first match unless all=true; validate intended substitutions against representative text before modifying project files.

Retrieve playback from AnimationTree parameters; travel follows an internally computed shortest state path but teleports when disconnected, with reset_on_teleport controlling restart. Assert the travel path when transitions must be honored.

Current node changes when crossfade begins; state_finished waits until fading-source influence disappears. Fade position/length are separate from each state play position/length; non-reset transitions may expose remaining length.
Grouped-machine state signals prefix nested names; next immediately advances only when a travel or auto-advance next path exists.
HingeJoint3D constrains relative body rotation to an axis; angular limits and motor each need their enable flag before limit or target-speed parameters take effect.

Angular-limit softness is deprecated and unused, so do not offer it as a tuning fix. Motor max_impulse prose calls it acceleration without defining units; verify backend binding/behavior before treating it as force or acceleration.
3D obstacle outlines project to XZ: vertex Y is ignored, global Y positions the shape and height extrudes it. Baking subtraction and carving require explicit bake participation.

Ground-plane avoidance uses outline and radius with vertical height filtering; true 3D avoidance uses only radius. Velocity prediction applies only to radius, not static outlines, so match avoidance modes and avoid per-frame outline rebuilding.
Winding controls inward versus outward avoidance; returned vertices are copied and node set_navigation_map must update both node and server state.
VisualShaderNode is a graph Resource rather than a scene-tree Node; port types map to shader float/int/uint/vector/bool/mat4 and sampler-uniform references with sampler placement restrictions.

Bulk defaults use alternating port-index/value pairs, not a plain value list. Default connection port selection supports drag-to-create editor behavior; preview and parent graph-frame indices -1 disable those associations.

Parent the modifier under Skeleton3D and implement _process_modification_with_delta after AnimationMixer playback; apply full pose results because Skeleton3D performs influence blending, avoiding double weighting.
Callbacks can run immediately at initialization with delta zero outside normal process/physics callbacks; guard temporal calculations and validate bone names/indices on skeleton changes.
Sample modified poses at modification_processed rather than arbitrary process timing; get_skeleton can return null without a valid parent. Old _process_modification is deprecated.
Feature profiles reduce editor UI clutter; hiding a class, disabling its inspector editing and hiding one property are separate operations and do not define engine runtime restrictions.

Disabling 3D hides its editor but leaves 3D classes in node creation; scene-tree feature makes the dock read-only, contradicting generic claims that all disabled features vanish. Signals/Groups replace deprecated Node dock.
Export/load JSON profiles with Error checks and locate UI-managed .profile files through EditorPaths config directory, then verify reload preserves the intended settings.
Texture parameter semantics distinguish raw data from source_color sRGB conversion, normal-map hints and anisotropy flow maps; default missing texture color is independently configured.

Non-mipmap filters do not sample mipmaps even when present; mipmapped options can select nearest mip based on project configuration, while anisotropic quality is useful chiefly for oblique 3D surfaces.

Screen, depth and normal-roughness sources use different render buffers; screen prose describing opaque objects is a 3D capture convention and must not be generalized to all shader types or renderer availability.
Experimental CCDIK rotates mapped Bone2D chains toward a target using a separately located chain tip, generally a child marker on the last bone; joint data records are not scene bones.

Enable constraints before min/max affect solving; inverted constraints allow angles outside the interval rather than reversing min/max. rotate_from_joint changes the reference from default tip-based rotation, requiring reachable/unreachable target tests.

This undescribed extension interface exposes required channel lifecycle, poll, queue counts, metadata, ordering, negotiated state and write-mode virtuals; native packet methods use raw pointer buffers.

Native WebRTC provider implementation is the mapped boundary, not a turnkey gameplay recipe. Buffer ownership/lifetime and failure semantics are absent from this reference and must be verified against pinned implementation before supplying extension code.

Built-in physical camera feeds are documented only on Linux/Android/macOS/iOS, with iOS camera export module required; Windows camera availability cannot be claimed from this class. Device/permission validation remains platform-specific and untested.

Feed datatype may be RGB, packed YCbCr, separate Y/CbCr or external; separate data needs shader recombination except automatic environment backgrounds. Check format-set success and observe frame_changed before declaring capture works.

YUYV output parameters distinguish RGB conversion, separate planes, grayscale and raw copy; feed transform handles image orientation and backend texture ID is an external-library handle rather than a portable RenderingDevice RID.

AnimatedSprite2D plays SpriteFrames; changing animation resets frame/progress, while set_frame_and_progress can preserve phase between matching skins. Check frame compatibility before transferring phase.
is_playing remains true at zero speed, so test frame advancement and effective speed. pause preserves phase, stop resets position/custom speed, and same-name play resumes rather than forcing restart.

Non-loop completion pauses and emits animation_finished; loops emit animation_looped instead. Centering odd-sized pixel art can cause subpixel placement, requiring visual checks and appropriate centering/snap decisions.

AcceptDialog starts invisible and uses Window popup methods; confirmed, canceled and custom_action separate acceptance, close/cancel and named custom actions. Registering LineEdit enter triggers acceptance.

Disable hide_on_ok to validate custom input before hiding, but FileDialog has independent built-in validation/hiding behavior. Preserve required internal Label/OK button; hiding is supported, freeing them is unsafe.
remove_button only detaches custom added buttons and disconnects dialog action behavior without freeing the button; dispose separately when appropriate and verify repeated popup/button lifecycle.

SceneTree supplies the default API and can override individual branches for isolated client/server instances. Connect client-only success/failure/server-disconnect separately from peer lifecycle signals; has_multiplayer_peer only means assigned.

Capture remote sender ID before await because it is RPC-context-dependent and becomes zero outside execution. Manual poll executes RPCs in its caller context, requiring appropriate thread and physics safety.

RPC authority mode restricts caller, any_peer does not validate gameplay intent. The convenience example my_method.rpc(peer,args) ambiguously treats peer as an argument; targeted calls need rpc_id binding verification rather than copying it.

Separate global import-dock options from per-category 3D import-dialog options; add options only inside the corresponding option-definition callbacks and query them only during visibility/processing callbacks.

Visibility returns true/false/null to show/hide/ignore, while preview-update callback requests 3D view refresh. pre_process runs immediately after loading and may adjust _subresources keys before final configuration; post_process runs afterward.

Internal processing distinguishes node/mesh/material/animation/skeleton categories, but missing category descriptions require binding/source verification for unsupported assumptions. Reimport tests must prove transformations remain deterministic.
Geometry helpers operate on supplied coordinates rather than physics-world objects; box planes use half-extents and faceted capsule/cylinder planes use configurable axes, sides and latitude steps.

Capped segment projection differs from uncapped infinite-line projection. Triangle intersections return Vector3 or null while convex/cylinder/sphere segment intersections return point/normal pairs or empty arrays.
Barycentric weights interpolate triangle vertex data; Delaunay tetrahedralization returns groups of four source-point indices and an empty array on failure, requiring index/degeneracy checks.
EngineDebugger is the running-game side of editor messaging/profiling; check active state, register uniquely named captures/profilers and unregister on shutdown.

Runtime capture strips its name prefix unlike EditorDebuggerPlugin capture; callbacks receive message and Array and return whether recognized. Validate both directions rather than assuming identical payload conventions.
line_poll processes debugger events during busy execution; experimental depth/line stepping controls are debugger-integration mechanisms, not ordinary gameplay-loop optimization APIs.

Prefer UPDATE_ONCE for static probes; radiance roughness generation spans subsequent frames, movement refreshes a probe but changed nearby geometry alone does not. UPDATE_ALWAYS is costly and the page recommends at most one.

Capture cull_mask and receiver reflection_mask solve different problems; Mobile needs mesh/probe AABB overlap and shader-displaced geometry may need extra_cull_margin. Mobile supports eight probes per mesh whereas Compatibility supports two.

Probe capture reads WorldEnvironment rather than camera overrides. Box projection suits rooms; max_distance cannot shrink capture below probe extents, so diagnose size and distance together. Visual results remain untested.

position is relative to the parent; to_global expects a point in this node local space, so converting its own position applies its transform twice. to_local is suitable for child coordinates rather than this node parent-relative position.

look_at aims local positive X at a global point and a coincident target points right. Negative X scale decomposes into negative Y and 180-degree rotation; inspect transform equivalence rather than expecting the original signed scale tuple.
move_local_x/y normalize scale unless scaled is true; skew is in radians on X between rotation and scaling even though the Inspector edits degrees.

CSGPolygon3D is a prototyping tool with expensive creation and CSG-relative movement; avoid treating dynamic CSG as cheap gameplay geometry. A self-intersecting polygon or fewer than three points produces no mesh, and the returned polygon array requires reassignment after edits.

Depth extrudes toward negative Z, spin revolves about Y, and path mode depends on Path3D and rotation policy. POLYGON and PATH rotation modes require continually decreasing path Z for viable geometry; PATH_FOLLOW tracks roll.

path_local selects the starting transform, path_interval_type selects meter distance versus subdivisions, and accurate tangents trade quality against approximation. Simplify angle merges extrusions; material UV allocation reserves separate end-face quarters.

Custom networking backends must implement the required lifecycle, polling, sender, channel, transfer mode, and identity callbacks; unique IDs must lie between 1 and 2147483647. Server relay support and refusal state are separate capabilities.

The introduction says all methods must be implemented, but native pointer packet callbacks and PackedByteArray script callbacks are alternatives; the script versions are specifically documented for GDScript subclasses. Follow required markers and selected binding rather than implementing both blindly.

Packet buffer lifetime and transport reliability are not specified by this page; a native backend requires binding/source review and two-peer failure tests rather than claiming completeness from callback stubs.

XRServer registers interfaces and trackers but availability alone does not initialize an interface; select one whose initialization succeeds. React to tracker_added, removed, and updated for changing controllers or AR anchors.

center_on_hmd needs available tracking data, often after startup frames, and rotation mode plus keep_height must match the intended recenter behavior. clear_reference_frame reverses its reference-frame adjustment.

world_origin is managed by XROrigin3D and exposed for extensions; default world scale assumes one unit per meter. camera_locked_to_origin is intended for controlled benchmarking/testing and the page warns it is uncomfortable for users. XR device behavior remains untested.

The tracking provider converts data to the Godot Humanoid hand skeleton and registers XRHandTracker; XRHandModifier3D applies it to a mesh. Joint indices enumerate 26 palm, wrist, finger, and tip joints rather than arbitrary mesh bone indices.

Check has_tracking_data and individual validity/tracked bit flags before consuming pose or velocity. A valid orientation or position can remain without active tracking, while velocity validity is independent.

hand_tracking_source distinguishes unobstructed sensor tracking, controller-inferred joints, unknown source, and no tracking; controller-derived joints must not be treated as precise optical measurements. Coordinate conventions and velocity units need related provider references and device tests.

Decals require Forward+ or Mobile; Compatibility has none. Mobile allows eight per mesh and requires visibility AABB overlap; cull_mask and extra_cull_margin diagnose unexpected receivers or missing shader-deformed receivers.

Normal-only or ORM-only decals still need an albedo alpha mask with albedo_mix zero; decal transparency cannot override underlying material transparency. ORM roughness affects ReflectionProbe reflections but not SSR, VoxelGI, or SDFGI reflections.
Decal filtering is project-wide, distance fade eventually culls decals, and thin hard-surface volumes improve culling when vertical fade is disabled. Modulate alpha does not scale emission.
C# copy-texture examples pass an integer to enum-typed methods; verify generated bindings and use a DecalTexture enum conversion when compiling an original recipe.
Ragdoll raycasts require the parent PhysicalBoneSimulator3D modifier active and a valid assigned skeleton bone ID; distinguish allowed simulation from currently simulating via the two query methods.

Use _integrate_forces for precise body-state control instead of setting linear_velocity every rendered frame. custom_integrator disables standard gravity and damping while retaining collision response.

Impulses are one-time events and positioned impulse offset is in global coordinates relative to body origin. Damping defaults combine with world or Area settings; replace mode with zero removes those damping contributions, but numerical/backend energy behavior still needs runtime verification.

PackedInt32Array stores signed 32-bit values and overflowing values wrap even though GDScript int is 64-bit. Bound-check data before narrowing; byte conversion uses four bytes per element and does not by itself define a portable protocol.

Packed arrays share references unless duplicated, but built-in returned properties are copies that need reassignment. get rejects negative indices and returns zero on error, unlike indexing which supports negative indices and errors out of bounds.

bsearch requires sorted input and returns an insertion index even when absent. resize returns an Error code rather than final size; check size after allocation and prefer one resize plus assignment for large batches.

Curve2D control handles are relative to each vertex, while closest-point inputs and results are curve-local. Convert world coordinates through the owning Path2D before queries and transform sampled results back as needed.

sample uses segment index and normalized t, samplef combines those, whereas sample_baked uses pixel distance along cached geometry. Baked rotation aims its X basis along the path; zero-length curves return an empty transform.

Lower bake_interval increases cache density and memory; changing it invalidates caches. Curvature tessellation and nearly even-length tessellation serve different tasks and subdivision stages can exponentially increase point count.

CanvasItem fragment COLOR already includes vertex color, modulate, self_modulate, and the default texture; multiplying it by TEXTURE again double-samples the texture. Preserve vertex-only color through a varying when replacing texture sampling.

skip_vertex_transform bypasses model-to-world conversion while later canvas/projection conversion still occurs. SCREEN_TEXTURE was removed; declare a hint_screen_texture sampler. TIME rolls over, follows Engine time_scale, and ignores pause, so custom time uniforms are needed for different timing contracts.

A custom light function replaces default lighting even if empty; Godot 4 performs lighting in the regular draw pass. NORMAL_MAP converts 3D-style normals to 2D, and SDF helpers need LightOccluder2D SDF Collision.

FRAGCOORD descriptions incorrectly claim the bottom-right is (1,1) while describing pixel screen coordinates; use SCREEN_UV for normalized positions and verify actual pixel coordinates in a rendered diagnostic before adopting this prose.

TwoBoneIK3D uses a required pole target and deterministic two-circle geometry; method index refers to settings entries rather than skeleton bone IDs. Establish root-middle-end hierarchy before choosing named or numeric bones.
