Intervening bone rotations are ignored and joint-to-joint lines become virtual bones. End-tail extension and a virtual end from the middle are distinct settings, so use the one matching the actual rig.

Pole direction must not be collinear with the forward vector; zero pole vectors mean no secondary direction. Diagnose unexpected twist through pole geometry, hierarchy, and target paths, then verify the final modifier pose.

Standard alpha blend can sort incorrectly; discard gives binary edges, opaque prepass adds cost, and hash uses a spatial threshold. render_priority only affects transparent sorting when alpha_cut is disabled and cannot reorder against opaque geometry.
fixed_size compensates distance but still responds to camera FOV or projection size. no_depth_test still obeys draw order; billboard shadows with multiple cameras have undefined orientation behavior.

SpriteBase3D modulate does not support overbright values; material overrides must consume vertex colors or modulation disappears. pixel_size converts texture pixels to world dimensions and positive offset Y moves up in world space; generate_triangle_mesh follows current axis and pixel size.

bind appends arguments after call-time arguments, unbind discards rightmost call-time arguments, and chained adapters apply right to left. get_argument_count includes optional parameters and adjusts for bind/unbind, so it is not a minimum-arity count.

Non-null does not imply callable validity; check is_valid when targets may be freed. Deferred calls drain within the same idle cycle, so self-deferring loops can recurse indefinitely rather than waiting for another frame.
Callable.create avoids Dictionary key/method ambiguity. C# default parameters are not supplied by Callable calls and invalid calls may fail silently, so verify actual callback behavior.

rpc broadcasts arguments, while rpc_id takes a target peer ID; this confirms the targeted rpc(peer,args) advice in MultiplayerAPI prose should be corrected in original recipes. Both require RPC-configured methods.

PackedFloat64Array offers double storage with lower memory and iteration overhead than Array[float], while PackedFloat32Array reduces memory further at reduced precision. Packed data lacks general Array map-style convenience methods.
NaN disrupts equality searches, erase, counts, sorting, and binary-search assumptions; sanitize or explicitly handle NaNs in stored measurements rather than treating failed lookup as absence.

Built-in returned packed properties are copies needing reassignment, whereas ordinary passed packed arrays share references. resize returns status and should be followed by a size check; get rejects negative indices but [] supports them, and byte conversion emits eight bytes per value.

Experimental XRBodyTracker contains provider data converted to the Godot Humanoid skeleton and XRBodyModifier3D applies it; its 87 joint constants include optional scapula, heel, and twist joints and must not be conflated with arbitrary mesh bone IDs.

body_flags independently describe upper-body, lower-body, and hand capability; has_tracking_data and per-joint orientation/position valid/tracked flags must gate consumers. Valid data may remain during temporary tracking loss, so plan a fallback pose rather than assuming tracking is live.

Provider registration, coordinate conventions, and device-specific support need XR runtime documentation and hardware tests; this class reference alone does not demonstrate a working body-tracking setup.

Add PopupMenu children to create menu items; their titles derive from Window.title then node name, with per-menu override methods. Disabled, hidden, and shortcut-disabled states require separate checks.

prefer_global_menu can make the Control zero-sized and hide all non-PopupMenu children when system menus are supported; check is_native_menu before diagnosing missing local layout. The bar preference overrides child prefer_native_menu.

Language controls shaping/line breaking and text_direction controls base writing direction; theme has mirrored style states for RTL. MSDF outline clipping requires pixel range at least twice outline_size. Global/native menu behavior remains platform-specific and untested.
GDScript int is signed 64-bit with wraparound, whereas C# int is 32-bit and long matches its width. Automatic float-to-int conversion truncates; converting large integers to float can lose exactness.
Integer division truncates and remainder can be negative for negative dividends; use floating operands for fractional results and posmod for nonnegative cyclic indexing.

Bit masks use AND to test and OR to set bits; bitwise shifts need explicit input constraints because the page equivalence to multiplication/division does not describe negative or overflow edge cases. String constructor follows String.to_int parsing rules rather than strict validation.

Noise outputs are usually within minus one to one but cellular modes can exceed one; measure or clamp the chosen algorithm when converting noise to height, color, or occupancy thresholds. Pin seed and all settings for reproducible generation.

Noise type, fractal octaves/gain/lacunarity, and domain-warp settings are independent choices. Domain warp adds another noise evaluation path; progressive and independent octave warping produce different distortions and should be measured at target map size.

Cellular return type selects cell identity versus nearest/second-nearest distance combinations, while jitter controls point displacement and zero restores an even grid. Smooth simplex and cubic value improve some artifacts at added cost; procedural-terrain recipes still need seam and regeneration tests.

PackedVector3Array construction needs Vector3 elements rather than flattened coordinate triples. It reduces storage overhead relative to Array[Vector3] but built-in returned packed values need reassignment after edits.

array multiplied on the right by Transform3D performs inverse transformation and assumes an orthonormal basis; use affine_inverse on the left for scaled or skewed inverse transformations. Test translated and scaled points to prevent coordinate-direction mistakes.

Sorting and equality searches are unreliable with NaN components; get returns zero vector for invalid or negative indices whereas [] supports negative indices. Byte layout is not detailed here and must be version/build verified before native or network interchange.

HTTPRequest creation returning OK means accepted work, not server response; independently check request_completed result, HTTP response code, and payload parsing. One node supports one in-flight request; the sample sequential GET/POST calls would encounter busy and are explicitly reference-only.

Set body_size_limit for decompressed size, timeout in real seconds independently of time_scale, and handle unknown body length minus one for chunked progress. download_file introduces distinct open/write failure results.

Original image/JSON examples need early returns on transport/decode errors and JSON parse checks rather than only push_error then continuing. Android exports require INTERNET permission; TLS options and proxy configuration follow HTTPClient limitations.

accept_gzip controls both automatic gzip/deflate decompression and default Accept-Encoding; user headers suppress automatic header insertion. Progress counts and decompressed payload size should not be assumed interchangeable.

Experimental composition layers present a SubViewport at compositor resolution for clear XR text; unsupported types can use a viewport-textured fallback mesh. Native support queries are accurate only after session start and sort_order has no effect on fallback meshes.

Transparent presentation needs alpha_blend plus a transparent viewport background; negative sort_order with hole punching supports apparent 3D occlusion. Eye restrictions and swapchain filtering/swizzle options depend on runtime extensions.

Android surfaces replace layer_viewport and only exist on Android during an active OpenXR session. protected_content takes effect at initial surface creation and later changes do not retroactively apply.
intersects_ray takes global origin/direction and returns UV or (-1,-1); map valid UVs to viewport input separately. All headset/native-versus-fallback visual behavior remains untested.

The generated all-classes index groups globals, Nodes, Resources, other objects, editor-only classes, and Variant types. These groups overlap: Node, Object, Resource, and editor classes can appear in multiple trees, so page enumeration must deduplicate paths rather than treat every toctree appearance as another page.

Editor-only listings explicitly include importers, export platforms, editor interfaces, and script-editor facilities; expose these through editor-tools/export workflows rather than promise their presence in game runtime exports.

The index includes low-level render/native/XR structures and compact math/data types alongside gameplay nodes. Use it as an on-demand API routing map and preserve research boundaries for engine/provider integration instead of inventing a tutorial for every entry.

Windows presets support x86_32, x86_64, and arm64 with optional embedded PCK and debug/release template overrides; package relocation must include runtime DLLs and use matching architecture. export_d3d12/export_angle automatic inclusion depends on configured driver, while explicit inclusion supports alternative runtime paths.

modify_resources enables icon and executable metadata changes; file/product versions fall back to project version. The console-wrapper export option is typed int although its prose describes a bool, so verify actual preset option values rather than hardcode a boolean.
Shader baking supports Forward+ and Mobile and is disabled for dedicated-server exports. Texture format choices and driver packaging are separate from choosing a renderer at runtime.

Signing identity, identity type, and password have environment overrides; do not expose passwords in evidence. SSH deployment and signing require their actual external tooling and target verification; these reference options alone are not a passed export test.

create_from_surface accepts ArrayMesh triangle surfaces and populates vertex/edge/face adjacency; commit_to_surface appends a new surface rather than replacing the source. Preserve unrelated surfaces and inspect both Error returns when modifying an existing mesh.

Face vertex/edge slots are zero through two and edge endpoints zero through one. get_format identifies available attribute arrays; tangents are encoded in Plane xyz with d sign, not a geometric tangent plane.

The introductory example still instantiates MeshInstance instead of MeshInstance3D in both languages. Its clear_surfaces approach only fits its one-surface scratch mesh and must not erase unrelated surfaces in project-edit recipes.

Clockwise triangles define front faces. Displacing duplicated flat-shaded vertices along normals separates faces; geometric deformation also needs deliberate normal/tangent updates and saved mesh readback rather than assuming shading follows automatically.

Curve3D baked offsets are distances in 3D units, while sample/samplef use segment parameterization. Handles are vertex-relative and closest-point queries are curve-local; convert through Path3D for world-space interactions.

closed connects endpoints only with more than two control points; baking density trades memory against approximation. Oriented path following requires up_vector_enabled and missing up vectors return a default up vector with an error.

Tilt is in radians and apply_tilt is optional in baked orientation sampling; returned basis uses Z forward rather than silently adopting a model negative-Z convention. Zero-length orientation aligns to global axes. The sample t range prose contains a reversed inequality; use normalized zero-to-one t.

AABB size must be nonnegative; abs returns equivalent bounds with corrected origin. Boolean truth is not a volume test, so use has_volume/has_surface and is_finite for validation. expand, grow, and merge return new bounds and require assignment.

intersects excludes touching edges while intersection can return a zero-volume flat box; encloses includes edges. Ray/segment tests return Vector3 or null, so a zero-vector hit must not be rejected by a truthiness check.

Right-side AABB times Transform3D is inverse transformation with an orthonormal assumption; use affine_inverse for scaled or skewed inverse transforms. Bounds tests are broad-phase geometry helpers rather than a replacement for physics collision queries.

Build an ARRAY_MAX slot array with correctly sized optional attributes and an index array for indexed geometry; add blend-shape names before surfaces and match blend vertex/normal/tangent presence to the base arrays. LODs select alternate indices with distance-related keys.

surface_remove shifts later indices; additions append surfaces, so identify intended surfaces and preserve names/materials during project modifications. regen_normal_maps regenerates tangents, not normals, despite its name.

custom_aabb covers shader-deformed geometry for frustum culling. shadow_mesh may fuse vertices and omit shading attributes but must preserve exact source positions including LOD positions, rather than supply an arbitrary simplified silhouette.

attribute and skin region-update descriptions repeat vertex-coordinate byte layout and likely do not describe actual attribute/skin packing correctly. Query format stride and offsets from RenderingServer and verify version-matched sources plus readback before constructing byte updates; do not blindly assume twelve-byte skin/attribute records.
clip_text changes horizontal clipping and minimum width; it does not clip vertically. Autowrap and overrun settings require separate layout decisions.
align_to_largest_stylebox stabilizes minimum size and text/icon placement across interaction states; otherwise current-state margins can visibly shift content.
Focused font and icon colors replace normal colors only; hover, pressed and disabled states take precedence. Preserve a visible focus StyleBox for keyboard and controller navigation.
Expanded icons preserve aspect ratio and respect theme icon_max_width; centered icon and text can overlap. Theme h_separation and StyleBox content margins control spacing.
Mirrored StyleBoxes support RTL layouts. MSDF outlines require a font pixel range at least twice the outline size.

Experimental face trackers register with XRServer and expose Unified Expressions weights; provider capability and avatar blend-shape names require an explicit mapping rather than direct mesh-index assignment.

BlendShapeEntry has 143 usable entries before FT_MAX, including separate left/right expressions and combined convenience expressions; distinguish jaw opening, mouth closing, tongue and eye signals to avoid driving incompatible morphs together.

blend_shapes returns a copy: edit and reassign it or use set_blend_shape. The page provides no guaranteed tracking-validity flag, weight normalization or availability contract; inspect the provider and device behavior.

The descriptions of FT_MOUTH_LOWER_DOWN_RIGHT and LEFT say pulls up although their names and combined FT_MOUTH_LOWER_DOWN describe down; verify against the expression standard and provider before implementing mappings. Device tracking remains untested.

This is a Script resource extension interface with many required virtual methods, including language identity, introspection, source handling, instantiation and reload; it is not a general gameplay script base.

Native void-pointer instance and placeholder callbacks lack ownership descriptions in this page. Most methods and the class itself are undocumented; a runnable language integration recipe requires version-matched engine bindings and implementation sources.
_instance_has is deprecated and never called by the engine. _is_abstract prevents direct instantiation and changes visibility in Create New Node.

_get_script_method_argument_count can return null when undetermined to invoke default behavior; do not replace unknown counts with zero. Engine language implementation remains an explicit research boundary.

Native dialogs, tray indicators, global menus, title decorations and taskbar progress have distinct platform and embedded-game restrictions. Query DisplayServer features and test a standalone exported process; the introductory native-Wayland multiwindow restriction needs reconciliation with Window and display-driver sources.

Window-state persistence uses a dedicated user ConfigFile but the sample ignores load/save Error results, screen index validity, disconnected displays and offscreen positions. The enum type-test and unqualified FEATURE_EXTEND_TO_TITLE example need parser verification.

macOS notification text is interpolated into AppleScript without escaping user-controlled quotes; argument arrays avoid shell interpolation but do not protect the embedded language. Do not copy this example for arbitrary notification contents.

Low-processor mode draws on change, but animations and TIME shaders can force continuous redraw. Debug Canvas Item Redraws identifies causes; the sleep interval defines a maximum frame rate rather than guaranteed throughput. Dummy audio/physics save resources only when their capabilities, including object picking, are unnecessary.

Overlay transparency requires both window and viewport configuration and a compositor on X11; passthrough settings govern input separately. Capture exclusion is best effort, and exclusive fullscreen can hide overlays.

Screen-reader accessibility uses names, descriptions and navigation order and works with Dummy audio. Native screen-scale support varies by display driver, so manual UI scaling and scaled minimum window sizes remain necessary.

Embed PCK does not package native extension dependencies automatically; portable preferences require a writable executable directory and handling ConfigFile errors. Custom templates and installer creation belong to delivery workflows, while engine source compilation remains a separately stated boundary.

ColorPicker is the embedded VBoxContainer widget; ColorPickerButton supplies a popup trigger. Presets and recent colors belong to each picker, so application-wide palettes need explicit persistence and synchronization.

MODE_RGB edits sRGB, MODE_LINEAR edits linear components and replaces deprecated MODE_RAW; intensity applies a power-of-two multiplier in linear space before returning sRGB encoding. This differs from multiplying nonlinear RGB components directly.

deferred_mode applies color after mouse release instead of every motion event, useful when color_changed triggers expensive material or asset updates; verify keyboard and controller behavior separately rather than assuming a universal debounce.

Alpha and intensity editing and visibility of shape, sampler, presets and sliders are independent. Preserve transparent focus overlays for keyboard/controller navigation and ensure overbright and revert icons remain legible against varying colors.
GPU 2D particle collision uses LightOccluder2D, not PhysicsBody2D. collision_base_size applies only to rigid or hide-on-contact ParticleProcessMaterial collision and approximates particle shape.
Reducing amount_ratio changes emissions without restarting but does not reduce allocation and processing costs; lower amount for a fixed quality tier and measure the restart behavior.

One-shot finished is never emitted for continuous emitters. GPU completion may delay reactivation via emitting=true; restart immediately begins a new cycle but clears existing particles, so pooling and cleanup must respect the intended effect lifetime.

visibility_rect controls whether the system remains active; expand or generate it when particles pop at screen edges. capture_rect synchronizes threaded rendering and is unsuitable for constant bounds polling.

Preprocessing work scales with seconds times fixed_fps, with a 30-Hz fallback at zero; large values can create a single-frame GPU workload. Trails increase mesh complexity, and interpolation smooths a lower particle update cadence rather than changing elapsed simulation speed.

emit_particle is unavailable in Compatibility, and default ParticleProcessMaterial can overwrite supplied color and interprets custom as rotation, age, animation and lifetime. Flipbook display needs a separate CanvasItemMaterial; process shaders and draw materials have different responsibilities.

For reproducible capture, enable use_fixed_seed, specify seed and preserve it across restart. request_particles_process with speed_scale zero can seek emitting and residual phases; visual determinism still requires target-renderer validation.
Font size belongs to consuming nodes, allowing one font resource across sizes. Theme defaults, per-node overrides and LabelSettings have distinct precedence; LabelSettings outranks theme properties.

Pixel fonts need nearest filtering at the consuming CanvasItem, integer design-size and node-scale multiples, and disabled dynamic subpixel positioning. MSDF uses grayscale antialiasing without hinting and needs pixel range at least twice outline size.

MSDF reduces per-size rasterization and large-font first-use stalls but increases baseline rendering cost and small-glyph generation cost. CPU rasterization means GPU upgrades do not solve glyph-generation stalls; preregister needed glyphs and measure cache, startup and memory.

Prerender glyphs using shaped translations, custom strings or character sets. Translation changes do not automatically update configurations; account for sizes in traditional rasterization and unknown user text in coverage.

Use explicit fallback fonts for predictable CJK, emoji and private-use icons. Ligature-based icon names cannot override main-font glyphs via fallback. System fonts vary in metrics and platform support, are unavailable on web, and Android lookup can fail on vendor configurations.

Emoji support depends on embedded PNG/SVG formats; COLR/CPAL and iOS EMJC are unsupported in this snapshot. Verify the actual bundled font format and license rather than assuming an operating-system emoji font works.

FontVariation glyph transforms do not change advances; adjust spacing to prevent overlap and clipping. Prefer designed bold/italic or variable axes for quality, with faux variants as an explicit size/quality tradeoff.

The printable-ASCII example says quoted space-through-tilde equals 32-127 although tilde is 126; verify inclusive range sizes against atlas columns times rows before image-font import. Project default-font settings do not configure imported fonts.

Direct body state is intended for the RigidBody3D integration callback, where physics state changes are safe. Use state.step for simulation time and actual total gravity/damping rather than assuming project defaults.

Force is applied each physics update; impulse models a single impact. Positioned forces, impulses and get_velocity_at_local_position use a world-axis offset from the body origin despite the latter method name.

center_of_mass is a global-axis offset while center_of_mass_local is body-local. get_contact_local_position returns a world position in this snapshot; do not infer coordinate frames from local in a method name.

Constant force and torque accumulate until explicitly cleared. Documentation suggests property assignments although this direct-state class exposes getter/setter methods rather than constant_force/constant_torque properties; use the documented setters.
Torque requires nonzero inertia. The prose suggests setting inverse_inertia directly, but the property is getter-only here; configure body shape or body inertia and verify the effective state.

Contact count defaults to zero and needs appropriate RigidBody3D reporting configuration; reconcile contact_monitor with max_contacts_reported before asserting no collision. integrate_forces applies gravity and damping for a physics tick, so avoid double integration when retaining the built-in integrator.

XRInterface is implemented through native modules or GDExtension; gameplay scripts use its exposed configuration and capability interface. Availability, successful initialize, tracking quality and primary rendering ownership are separate states.

Successful initialization is followed by viewport.use_xr; devices using the main output need the main viewport while externally composited devices can use a separate XR viewport and spectator output. Use get_view_count and recommended render target size rather than assuming two eyes or window resolution.

Passthrough helper methods are deprecated in favor of supported environment blend modes. Check modes after runtime initialization, handle setter failure and preserve transparent viewport background for alpha passthrough; the sample omits checking the setter result.

Play area returns a convex polygon in virtual space around XROrigin3D and can be empty while unsupported or unavailable. Recompute on play_area_changed, including world-scale and recenter changes; stage mode may disable system recentering.

Haptic tracker_name is described as optional but has no default argument in the method signature; pass an explicit value. Frequency zero requests runtime default, amplitude is 0..1 and duration/delay are seconds. Device output remains untested.

XR_QUAD is enumerated but explicitly unsupported by Godot here. Runtime-specific system information and VRS texture formats need backend checks and must not be presented as universal device capabilities.

Light3D is abstract; choose directional, omni, spot or area subclasses. Physical lumens/lux take effect only with physical light units enabled; light_energy is an additional nonphysical strength multiplier and does not expand positional-light range.

Static bake mode leaves indirect illumination unchanged when the light moves or switches off. Dynamic indirect updates apply to VoxelGI/SDFGI rather than LightmapGI; light visibility does not exclude LightmapGI baking, while editor_only does.
Direct-light cull mask is ignored by GI and volumetric fog, while shadow_caster_mask controls shadow geometry separately. Diagnose leaked illumination by checking which lighting path generated it.

Omni/spot distance fading ultimately culls lights; shadow cutoff can occur earlier for additional savings. Directional PCSS requires Forward+, positional PCSS supports Forward+/Mobile and projectors also exclude Compatibility. These features carry separate shadow and shader costs.

Bias too low creates acne and too high separates shadows from casters; adjust normal bias alongside depth bias and verify multiple distances and surfaces. Reverse culling differs from explicitly enabling double-sided mesh shadows.

Transient lights can leave trails with volumetric-fog temporal reprojection; zero fog energy disables their contribution and saves processing. PCSS size is independent of Node3D scale, and light color is sRGB with correlated temperature tint applied separately.
shadow_transmittance_bias is undocumented here; retain an API index and verify implementation before proposing a troubleshooting recipe.

TileData describes a TileSet tile rather than arbitrary per-cell game state. Runtime per-cell alterations belong to TileMapLayer runtime-update hooks, with shared subresource handling checked against that class.

Physics, navigation, occlusion and custom-data layer IDs belong to separate TileSet layer collections. Check counts, custom-data existence and valid terrain peering directions before indexed access or mutation.

Constant linear and angular velocity describe the collision surface, enabling conveyor behavior without moving or rotating the tile itself. One-way settings and margins belong to each collision polygon.

Navigation and occlusion getters can apply flip and transpose arguments; texture-only flip properties do not establish a universal geometry-coordinate contract. Test asymmetric tile alternatives, collision and path geometry together.
Single-occluder accessors are deprecated in favor of indexed multiple polygons. Allocate polygon counts before setting indexed polygons and preserve unrelated layers.

Terrain center IDs and peering bits serve different roles; probability is a relative selection weight for random patterns. texture_origin, y_sort_origin and relative z_index address distinct drawing and sorting behavior.

Create DirAccess through open or create_temp, check null and thread-local get_open_error, and inspect Error results from mutations. change_dir cannot cross res/user/filesystem access scopes; reopen when changing scope.

Raw directory names in exported res paths reflect imported and remapped PCK contents. Use ResourceLoader.list_directory and ResourceLoader.exists for resource catalogs, and test the actual export rather than editor enumeration alone.

get_files/get_directories sort alphabetically while streaming get_next order is nondeterministic. get_next returns a basename, closes on exhaustion, and current_is_dir refers to the most recent entry; close streams explicitly when exiting early.

Temporary directory lifetime follows its returned RefCounted handle unless keep is true. Retain the handle while using files and verify cleanup failures instead of treating a path string as ownership.

remove permanently deletes files or empty directories and is not recursive; rename/copy can overwrite destinations. Preserve save backups, constrain cleanup paths, and use OS.move_to_trash for user-facing recoverable deletion.

Symlinks, junctions and reparse points require explicit recursion handling. is_equivalent tests filesystem identity rather than contents; case sensitivity and drive discovery depend on platform and filesystem, not an operating-system-wide assumption.

get_space_left returns zero on platform-query failure as well as possible full capacity; successful writes and error codes provide necessary evidence. Windows link creation requires Developer Mode or elevation and remains a separate environment condition.

Register a GLTFDocumentExtension instance with GLTFDocument. Instances are duplicated at import/export start, so retain configuration only and keep per-document/per-node state in additional_data rather than instance fields.

Preflight Error return determines whether the extension participates; supported extension names validate required glTF extensions. Select parse, pre-generate, per-node or final-scene hooks according to which data is available at that phase.

_generate_scene_node may receive null scene_parent for a single root; _export_node may receive null node for non-scene-generated data. Handle these paths and round-trip emitted JSON rather than assuming live scene nodes exist.

_export_get_property_list is an editor configuration hook that can run long before export or never run in programmatic export. _export_preserialize runs for each generated buffer or filesystem write and should avoid repeated destructive transformations.

Object-model mappings must specify types and valid JSON pointers or NodePaths; return null when unsupported. The import example uses split although the argument is split_json_pointer, requiring adaptation before copying.

Custom image exporters are selected by advertised image format; embedded serialization must set mimeType and return encoded bytes, while separate images require an importable extension. Mark used texture extensions required only when no fallback is supplied and test both embedded and external round trips.

Use forces and impulses for simulation-driven objects, or integration-callback direct state for precise control. Frequent transform/velocity assignment and moving rigid-body parents compete with simulation. Custom integration disables gravity/damping but retains collision response.

Body and shape collision signals require contact_monitor and a sufficient nonzero max_contacts_reported. Contact count counts manifold points rather than distinct bodies, and cached colliding lists do not update immediately after movement.
Map shape indices through shape_find_owner and shape_owner_get_owner rather than treating them as scene-child indices; server-only colliders or GridMap require guarding node assumptions.

Freeze static can be moved by code without swept path collision; freeze kinematic collides along movement and suits temporarily animated bodies. For permanently fixed or moving platforms prefer StaticBody3D or AnimatableBody3D.

Automatic center of mass and inertia do not update the exposed custom-value properties; inspect effective direct-state values with valid physics timing and guard null state and zero inverse-inertia components.
Damping combine adds body settings to area/default damping, replace overrides it. Sleeping_state_changed describes engine-originated changes and is not emitted by simply assigning sleeping.

Positioned force and impulse offsets use world axes relative to body origin, while constant forces persist until cleared. CCD helps fast small objects at extra cost, and set_axis_velocity changes the velocity component along its vector rather than adding a jump impulse.

Enable bbcode_enabled and properly nest tags; crossing tag ranges is unsupported. RichTextLabel preserves whitespace and supports a vertical scrollbar; formatting capabilities differ from documentation or console BBCode subsets.

Escape opening brackets in both names and messages before appending user text. Regex stripping is lossy, not a secure markup parser. meta_clicked does not open links automatically; validate application-specific metadata and URL schemes before calling OS.shell_open.

append_text parses only new markup, while text-property append reparses everything and erases push/pop changes. Threaded text processing avoids main-thread blocking but does not remove work; bound log size and measure layout completion.

Custom effects are installed per label and run per glyph during drawing, including outline passes. @tool is needed on the effect for editor preview; return true on successful processing and validate env types and zero-divisor parameters in the Ghost/Matrix samples.

Image percentage height is based on control width and em uses current font size. Image alt descriptions and named tables support accessibility; background/foreground highlight padding can overlap adjacent lines, and foreground paint does not remove underlying text.

Animated effects follow process mode when SceneTree pauses and movement can clip at label bounds. Preserve ligature grouping where needed; rainbow replaces text colors but not outline colors and still receives CanvasItem modulation.

The unordered bullet example uses [bullet=*] despite documented [ul bullet=*] syntax; check parser behavior. No BBCode vertical-centering tag exists, and code uses a monospaced theme font only when configured.

Atlas tiles must be explicitly created; a multi-cell tile is identified by its top-left coordinate, and get_tile_at_coords resolves covered cells or returns (-1,-1). Alternative zero is the base and cannot be removed through alternative deletion.

Cell flips and transpose occupy transformation bits in placed alternative IDs and can combine into quarter-turn rotations. Preserve the base alternative ID and existing flags when editing orientation.

Texture margins and separation are pixels, animation separation is grid units, and tile size is atlas cells. Query has_room_for_tile including all animation frames and ignore the existing tile when validating a move.

Texture/layout changes can automatically remove tile definitions. Preview get_tiles_to_be_removed_on_change, preserve TileData and placed-cell references, and implement undo/readback before modifying a shared atlas.

Padding produces a distinct runtime texture and runtime-region coordinates to prevent seams; match runtime regions with runtime texture rather than sampling the original atlas using padded coordinates. Resource modification rebuilds padding and consumes memory and processing time.

Animation total duration sums frame weights and must be divided by speed for the real loop duration; zero columns lays out a horizontal strip. Default starts synchronize while random starts vary instances, so test reproducible capture requirements.

create_alternative_tile returns its actual ID or -1 on failure. Moving/deleting tile coordinates or renumbering alternatives requires checking existing TileMapLayer references; this page does not promise automatic migration of all consumers.

Resolve bus names at use time and handle -1; adding, moving, deleting or renaming buses invalidates cached indices and emits layout/rename signals. set_bus_layout replaces the whole layout, so preserve routing and effects before modification.

Device names can fall back to Default when invalid; record effective driver and selected device. Headless selects Dummy audio and cannot prove physical playback, microphone behavior or latency. Audio playback_speed_scale is independent of Engine.time_scale.

Experimental direct microphone capture requires enable_input, permissions and successful set_input_device_active. get_input_frames returns exactly the requested stereo PCM frames or empty; use input mix rate and buffer capacity to choose polling intervals and stop the stream on cleanup.

Experimental sample playback is web-only here and does not support AudioEffects. Pre-register samples during loading to avoid first-play registration spikes; do not equate stream registration with zero cost.

get_output_latency reports effective driver latency and can be expensive; cache or query infrequently. Mix timing methods help synchronization but hardware latency still requires target-device measurement.

Effect resource configuration differs from per-channel AudioEffectInstance runtime data. Explicitly match bus, effect and channel and restore bypass/mute/solo state after diagnostics. Always pair AudioServer lock and unlock with minimal work.

OpenXR initialization occurs at engine startup through project settings; still mark a viewport use_xr. render_target_size_multiplier must be set before initialization, whereas foveation and supported refresh-rate queries require an initialized runtime.

Visible session output does not imply XR input focus: handle synchronized, visible, focused, stopping and loss states separately. The signal spelling session_focussed differs from SESSION_STATE_FOCUSED.

User presence extension queries are meaningful only after initialization, and presence-change signals omit startup/shutdown; explicitly establish initial presence and teardown behavior instead of waiting for a signal.

Direct OpenXR hand-joint APIs are deprecated in favor of XRHandTracker from XRServer. Preserve validity versus tracking flags and coordinate/world-scale semantics when migrating; controller-inferred hands are distinct from unobstructed tracking.

Vulkan foveation requires XR VRS mode; radius/strength are Forward+/Mobile conditions and subsampled images are a separate quality/performance tradeoff. Test actual runtime extension support before exposing settings.

CPU/GPU performance levels express runtime power/thermal preferences; boost may exceed thermally sustainable operation. React to warning/impaired notifications and measure sustained frame timing instead of claiming a guaranteed clock or FPS improvement. Headset validation remains untested.

Godot shader types are 32-bit and require explicit scalar/vector casting; GDScript uniform setters silently accept mismatched types, so compile and render diagnostic values and check 64-to-32-bit range loss. Matrices are column-major and multiplication follows linear algebra rather than component multiplication.

Initialize local variables and all switch branches. Array indices must satisfy 0 <= index < length, not the inclusive length implied by the prose; clamp to length-1 only after handling an empty array. Uniform arrays have no shader default and structs cannot be uniforms.

Global uniforms must exist before shader compilation; shader defaults are ignored. Runtime reads synchronize the rendering thread, so maintain script-side state and avoid repeated getters. The sample COLOR=my_color.rgb mismatches vec4/vec3 and needs correction and compilation.

Per-instance uniforms support scalar/vector types but no textures or arrays and have a practical 16-slot limit. Multi-material parameters must agree in name/index/type; a MultiMesh node instance parameter does not replace per-element custom data. Compatibility sampler-array indexing needs constant indices or an initialized switch fallback.

source_color applies to sRGB color textures, especially Forward+/Mobile and HDR 2D; normal/roughness/height data should remain unconverted. Keep texture filtering and repeat hints separate from color encoding.

Varyings are assigned in vertex or fragment processors, not custom or light functions. Flat interpolation preserves a primitive value while smooth is perspective-correct. Bound loops and avoid exact float equality; discard still incurs vertex work and can undermine depth-prepass efficiency.

Uniform capacity is backend-dependent with vector padding; pack large data into textures when needed. Cube-array and external samplers have distinct renderer/platform constraints. Precision modifiers are measured target-device choices rather than guaranteed mobile gains.

Global bone poses are skeleton-relative, not world transforms; convert with the skeleton global-transform affine inverse. Rest and pose are distinct and motion_scale changes actual position-track results relative to stored keys.

Read final modifier results at skeleton_updated or modification_processed rather than relying on pose_updated, which excludes modifier changes. Manual advance accumulates delta for deferred processing rather than guaranteeing immediate synchronous evaluation.

Bone parents must have lower indices; names are unique/nonempty and exclude colon/slash. Cache indices against get_version or bone_list_changed, and do not persist the instance-specific version as a content revision.

Physical bone controls and global pose overrides on Skeleton3D are deprecated; use explicit PhysicalBoneSimulator3D and SkeletonModifier3D workflows. force_update_all_bone_transforms is internal-only despite being exposed.
Repeated set_bone_global_pose can trigger dirty hierarchy recalculation; precompute local poses and batch set_bone_pose when applying many bones, then verify final skinning.

The pose-position descriptions claim skeleton-local coordinates while rotations are parent-bone-local, and localize_rests is described as resetting poses despite separate reset_bone_poses. Verify implementation and parented test cases before prescribing transform conversion or rest migration.
show_rest_only forces rest pose and disables editor pose editing; inspect it when animation seems ignored. Preserve skin binding and metadata when replacing or reimporting skeleton hierarchies.

Create tweens through Node or SceneTree; Tween.new is invalid. Create a fresh tween for each run and kill the previous owner of a property when restarting; retained references do not make a finished tween reusable.

Node binding controls tree/lifetime behavior, and bound-node pause semantics differ from time-scale ignoring. Tweens run after node callbacks in their selected idle/physics phase; choose physics mode for physics-timed updates and avoid competing property writers.

Steps are sequential unless parallel is selected; set_parallel also includes the immediately preceding tweener. chain starts a new sequential step and step_finished counts a parallel group as one step.

stop resets playback state/time but does not restore target values; next play can start from current property values. Initial tween_property values are captured when the step starts unless overridden by from/from_current.

AwaitTweener must be active when a signal emits; use timeout or a parallel await-before-emitting callback to avoid missed synchronous signals. Infinite loops never emit finished and need nonzero duration/delay; unbound paused/stopped tweens can remain indefinitely.

Subtweens inherit parent process/pause modes and pause/stop/loop changes can stall the parent. Test cancellation and bound-target deletion in composed cutscenes rather than only successful completion.

interpolate_value takes delta_value=final-initial and supports extrapolation, with duration zero returning final. The C# integer callback example supplies float from/to values and needs type-consistent actual invocation verification.

Vertex inputs start in model space, fragment VERTEX/NORMAL normally use view space, and POSITION overrides projection while fragment data still comes from VERTEX. Transform normals with a proper inverse-transpose for nonuniform scale; ensure_correct_normals is explicitly unimplemented. The render-mode table says BITANGENT while examples/built-ins use BINORMAL.

FRAGCOORD descriptions incorrectly label bottom-right as (1,1) despite pixel coordinates; SCREEN_UV is the normalized coordinate. Verify depth reconstruction using renderer clip-space conventions and set custom DEPTH on every branch.

Reading or writing ALPHA selects transparency with sorting and shadow/screen-texture limitations; distinguish blend modes, cutout/hash and alpha-to-coverage instead of assuming ALPHA=1 preserves opaque rendering. Shaded premultiplied alpha needs PREMUL_ALPHA_FACTOR.

Experimental stencil reads are restricted to the transparent pass, and the main stencil buffer cannot be copied for compositor effects. Test intended mask/depth interactions on each supported renderer.

Custom light functions run per light per pixel and should accumulate contributions with +=. Vertex lighting bypasses light(); the legacy force-vertex-shading project-path/default claim needs matching ProjectSettings verification. New area-light symbols in the sample are omitted from the built-in table and need compile/source checks.

shadows_disabled stops receiving shadows but does not stop casting. specular_disabled disables direct lobes while SPECULAR=0 also affects reflections. Separate scene-light controls from shader material outputs.

TIME is scaled but not paused and rolls over; use a custom uniform clock when required. INV_VIEW_MATRIX describes the current render pass, including shadow cameras; MAIN_CAM_INV_VIEW_MATRIX retains main-camera context.

Mesh vertex COLOR is clamped/quantized to 8-bit channels; use CUSTOM channels for higher precision data. Compatibility wireframe requires enabling generated wireframes before loading meshes; Z_CLIP_SCALE may break screen-space effects at aggressive values.

GLTFState holds per-file import/export state and extension additional_data so document extensions stay stateless. Root indices, child indices, meshes, skins, cameras, lights and texture source indices refer to distinct arrays; preserve referential integrity when adding or replacing entries.

add_used_extension must run before export_post. append_gltf_node must precede parent generation completion on import or parent export_node on export; allow null scene nodes and one scene node mapped to multiple glTF nodes.

Node mappings are partial and may return -1/null; multiple generated Godot nodes or missing nodes mean they are not strict bijections. root_nodes documentation conflates scenes and roots; inspect actual JSON scene roots rather than assuming one root per scene.

Image extraction mode is editor-only and becomes embedded uncompressed at runtime. Already-imported res images follow their image importer settings regardless of this property; choose binary-image memory/compression policy explicitly.
glb_data and root_nodes getters return copies and need reassignment after editing. base_path resolves external files, filename selects textual glTF versus GLB and is empty for buffer-only writes.

bake_fps affects animation import/export sampling; import_as_skeleton_bones forces a single skeleton, so validate hierarchy, animation and skinning round trips. Several low-level arrays and named-skin settings are undocumented, and get_animation_players_count has an unexplained required index argument; verify bindings rather than invent contracts.

Control children define slots; set_slot configures existing slot properties but does not create rows. GraphEdit connections use enabled-port indices rather than slot indices; use input/output port-slot mapping and stable model identifiers when children or enabled ports change.

Port types govern eligibility for connection_request, while the GraphEdit/application decides whether to accept the edge. Negative port types prohibit user-created connections; ignore_invalid_connection_type changes type eligibility but does not implement graph validation.

Slot metadata can associate domain data with left/right ports, while colors/custom icons and draw_stylebox remain presentation. Keep a separate graph model for serialization, dependency validation and undo.

slots_focus_mode exposes mouse-only, all-input and accessibility-only connection controls; verify navigation actions and visible focus/selected styles. slot_sizes_changed and slot_updated are appropriate triggers to recompute dependent visuals.
Use get_titlebar_hbox to add title controls instead of relying on undocumented internal child indices. _draw_port lacks a description here, so custom drawing needs source-backed behavior checks.

TileMap is deprecated; migrate layers through the editor extraction operation and use TileMapLayer for new work. Preserve existing TileMap calls while modifying legacy projects until deliberate migration and saved-state comparison are complete.

Updates batch at frame end, including scene-tile initialization after parent callbacks. update_internals forces work and is expensive; notify_runtime_tile_data_update marks changed results without immediate evaluation and should target a layer when possible.

Runtime TileData subresources are shared with TileSet; duplicate before mutation and opt in only affected cells. Disable layers stops rendering and physics, while hiding collision/navigation debug visuals does not disable simulation.

Legacy TileMap first layer uses World2D navigation map and later layers create separate maps. Select the matching agent map or assign a shared map deliberately; visible adjacent tiles do not prove cross-layer path connectivity.

Terrain connect/path operations may modify neighboring cells and need all required terrain combinations. Capture affected neighbors in undo/save tests, and verify ignore_empty_terrains semantics at borders.

local_to_map accepts local coordinates; map_to_local returns a cell center ignoring texture origin. Half-offset pattern placement needs map_pattern rather than coordinate addition, and neighbor helpers account for layout.

Saved coordinates wrap outside signed 16-bit range. Validate chunk/world coordinates before serialization; raw/proxy identifiers, atlas alternatives and scene-source IDs need separate handling. Rendering quadrants group square map-coordinate regions but do not apply to Y-sorted layers.

Arrays are shared by reference; Array(existing_array) aliases rather than copies. duplicate(true) copies nested arrays/dictionaries but retains Resources, whereas duplicate_deep controls subresource duplication. fill(reference) repeats the same object, and read-only state does not freeze nested contents.

Typed-array construction can convert elements and fails for already-typed base arrays; assign performs type conversions. Packed arrays generally reduce memory and iteration cost but lack convenience methods; choose based on actual element and ownership requirements.

get rejects negative indices and returns null on failure while [] supports negative indices and raises runtime errors. resize returns an Error, not the final length; check size after successful allocation.

Search is Variant-type-sensitive: integer and floating-point values may sort as equivalent yet has/find treat their types separately. Binary search requires a sorted array and returns insertion positions; bsearch_custom prose says behind while its example and sort_custom use before, so validate comparator convention.
Sorting is unstable and requires a consistent comparator; C# lacks sort_custom in this API. Preserve deterministic tie-breakers for game data and do not use randomized comparison as a shuffle.

Do not erase while iterating; front insertion/removal shifts indices and has linear cost. append_array avoids repeated concatenation copies, and queues benefit from an explicit head index or suitable data structure.

all on empty is true and any is false; reduce without an accumulator begins from the first element. Handle empty arrays explicitly in validation, max/min and random selection. Global-seed pick_random/shuffle are not independent RNG streams.
Equality checks content while hashes can collide; ordering is lexicographic followed by length. slice end is exclusive and reverse slices need the correct bounds and negative step.
Font is abstract; use FontFile, FontVariation or SystemFont and configure explicit fallback order. An empty FontVariation fallback list inherits its base font fallbacks.

Drawing positions specify the baseline, not the top; add ascent for a top origin. Character-by-character drawing or width summation breaks shaping, kerning and subpixel placement; use full-string/multiline shaping or TextLine.

Font-wide ascent/descent/height and underline metrics are rough estimates including fallbacks, not tight bounds for actual text. Use measured full-string bounds with matching font, size, direction, wrapping and justification settings.
The sample theme-font measurement omits LabelSettings, text transformations and shaping options, so it is only a basic single-line example rather than exact layout parity.

Font variation axes and features are font-specific and introspectable; use supported min/max/default values and preserve the resource when using returned cache RIDs. Palettes describe font glyph colors separately from modulation.

Per-call positive oversampling overrides viewport settings; LRU cache capacity affects draw methods. Measure CPU shaping/cache misses and memory before increasing capacities, and validate multilingual/ligature/RTL strings rather than only ASCII.

Use the EditorInterface singleton, with Singleton in C#; this is editor integration rather than exported gameplay API. Treat returned editor controls as borrowed objects and only free plugin-created UI.

close_scene discards pending edits, while save_scene returns an Error and save_scene_as/save_all_scenes do not return success codes. Inspect unsaved state and saved-resource readback before reload/close/restart operations.

EditorUndoRedoManager provides edit history, mark_scene_as_unsaved tracks scene changes and set_object_edited increments an edited version used for previews; use the appropriate mechanism rather than relying on visual inspector changes.

Popup helpers require an unparented Window and callbacks with specific String/NodePath types and cancellation values. The GDScript property-selector example passes this instead of self and requires correction.

Editor 2D viewport has canvas transforms rather than a camera; 3D views have indices 0..3 and camera access. Adapt custom overlays to the actual viewport and editor scale rather than game-window coordinates.

Multiwindow support depends on editor settings, embedded subwindows and command-line forcing; plugin enable names are directory names and feature profiles resolve from the editor config folder. Validate UI state in the intended editor configuration.

Main-screen plugins need expanding Control sizing; theme access should use node get_theme methods. is_playing_scene includes paused scenes, so debug tools should distinguish playing and paused behavior when driving editor actions.

Check open null/thread-local get_open_error, store-method bool results and get_error rather than copying unchecked introductory samples. WRITE/WRITE_READ truncate immediately; use temporary-save validation, backup/rename and recovery policy before replacing a valid save.

Reads advance a byte cursor except get_as_text, which reads whole UTF-8 text without affecting position. eof_reached only becomes true after over-reading; loop by position/length for regular files and verify get_buffer actual length for truncated data.

big_endian resets on open and must be configured afterward. Small integer stores wrap and need explicit signed decoding, while store_real/get_real depend on engine precision; use explicit fixed-width encodings and versioned schemas for portability.

UTF-8 byte lengths differ from String codepoint lengths. store_string has no length prefix, while Pascal strings and store_var provide retrievable encoding; validate declared lengths and resource bounds before decoding untrusted data.

get_var allow_objects can execute serialized code and must stay false for untrusted saves/network files. Object serialization only covers storage-flagged properties and is not an automatic complete gameplay snapshot.

FileAccess on exported res resources bypasses remapping; use ResourceLoader for imports, or include raw files through Keep File/export filters. open_compressed reads Godot-specific containers rather than generic gzip files.

GDScript closes on RefCounted lifetime, C# requires disposal; explicit close/readback and strategic flush reduce lost buffered writes but do not establish crash-atomic save behavior. Temporary file lifetime follows its handle unless keep is selected.

Extended attributes depend on filesystems and can disappear during transfers; Windows uses alternate streams. Timestamps zero and hashes empty indicate possible errors, while get_size uses -1; avoid conflating these sentinels with valid values. Encrypted opening requires a 32-byte key and does not by itself define tamper-resistant save policy.

Pair every registration and plugin-created UI insertion with removal on disable/exit, then free owned controls/docks. Borrowed editor UI must remain alive; repeated enable/disable should leave no duplicate menus, callbacks or importer registrations.

Prefer EditorDock/add_dock for new dock integrations; legacy bottom-panel and dock insertion methods are deprecated. Dock names retain LTR meanings even in RTL layouts, so verify positioning visually.

Use _handles/_edit/_make_visible with null-object cleanup and _clear when changing scenes. _build false aborts running and prevents later plugins building; return actionable diagnostic failures rather than blocking silently.

_get_state/_set_state store per-scene editor metadata and require plugin name; durable project settings belong elsewhere. Window-layout state is scene-independent. The sample saves preferred_color but reads my_color and uses Vector2 for Window position; correct keys/types and read back.

Viewport input forwarding consumes only intended events: 2D returns bool, 3D uses AfterGUIInput with Pass/Stop/Custom. The C# example ForwardCanvasGuiInput omits the underscore used elsewhere and needs compilation verification.

Main-screen controls require explicit insertion and visibility management. update_overlays schedules draw callbacks; draw only in appropriate callbacks and avoid grabbing all input when a tool is inactive.

Apply pending changes before save/tab changes, report unsaved external state and save successfully before clearing dirty flags. _run_scene replaces launch arguments, so preserve existing entries and ensure custom arguments are actually supported.

Choose import, scene-format, post-import, inspector, export, debugger or context-menu extension by task. add_custom_type is an editor creation convenience rather than a real runtime class; undo/redo inspector hooks capture dependent properties before destructive edits.

Image holds CPU pixels and must become ImageTexture for rendering. Check compressed status and decompression Error before mutation; compression APIs are editor-build-only, and some ETC formats cannot be decompressed by this API.

CPU Image MAX_WIDTH/MAX_HEIGHT constants are 16777216 while the prose cites 16384 hardware texture limits; distinguish resource bounds, practical allocation, format limits and device texture limits. Do not allocate based only on the enum constant.

Normalized 16-bit formats can fall back to float on unsupported devices; integer 16-bit images require unsigned samplers and nearest filtering in Compatibility. Verify actual texture format/sampling and quantization rather than assuming all Color values lie in 0..1.
blit overwrites pixels and alpha while blend alpha-composites; source/destination formats must match, and masks use nonzero alpha as a selection gate rather than a continuously weighted blend.

Mip generation replaces existing levels and renormalize is for normal maps. create_from_data expects supplied mip bytes rather than generating them. Mipmap count excludes base level, and get_data returns a copy.

Color-encoding decisions need shader source_color and texture-format verification. srgb_to_linear on 8-bit storage loses dark-color precision, and the broad automatic-conversion format notes and premultiply /256 formula need implementation checks rather than applying a second gamma conversion.

Load/save return errors or empty buffers; imported res assets may lack original files in exports. KTX loader supports only 2D images, codec modules can be excluded, and SVGZ must be decompressed before loading.

HDR screenshots saved as EXR should use color_image=true and Window.get_output_max_linear_value to constrain output; preserve float data for HDR and use reloaded pixel/metadata comparisons. JPEG loses alpha and remains lossy at quality 1; WebP dimensions cap at 16383.

Grayscale writes use red rather than computing luminance, and pixel readback can quantize/clamp. Use approximate comparisons and selected image metrics with fixed dimensions/encoding; visual equivalence and HDR display correctness remain separate untested outcomes.

Environment processing order is depth of field, exposure, glow, tonemap then adjustments. Several stages now belong to other resources; inspect effective camera/world settings. tonemap_mode prose still says HDR displays unsupported despite new HDR-specific properties and enums, so treat it as stale.

Filmic/ACES tonemappers, soft-light glow and built-in color-correction LUTs are SDR-limited here. AgX/Reinhard white adapts to window headroom with HDR2D; linear ignores tonemap_white. Distinguish scene exposure before tonemap from brightness/contrast adjustments afterward.

Mobile dynamic-range descriptions assume HDR2D disabled and 2D glow prose still claims all 2D is SDR; branch decisions must inspect use_hdr_2d and actual window output state. Compatibility uses a simpler glow path with many level/map/blend settings ignored.

Higher glow levels require processing lower levels even if their intensity is zero. Normalized levels sum to one; glow map multiplies RGB and ignores alpha, with aspect stretching and black areas potentially suppressing glow.
Ambient source, sky contribution and reflection source are independent. BG_KEEP can leave ghost trails whenever background becomes visible; do not choose it merely for its stated speed.

SDFGI is Forward+-only, uses static-GI geometry and supports dynamic lights but not dynamic occluders/emissive surfaces. Cascade/cell/distance settings are linked; small cells can cause camera-movement updates and stutter, while excessive bounce feedback risks runaway energy.

SSAO is documented Forward+/Compatibility, SSIL/SSR Forward+-only; reconcile older tutorials that omit Compatibility SSAO. SSR cannot show occluded surfaces and is unavailable with transparent viewport backgrounds; screen-space effects are supplementary, not complete GI.

Volumetric fog is Forward+-only and uses single scattering. Zero global density still permits FogVolumes; GI injection only includes VoxelGI/SDFGI, and temporal reprojection trades smoothing for moving-light/volume ghosting. Set transient light fog energy zero or validate reduced reprojection.

Bias/occlusion/wall thickness should be diagnosed together for SDFGI leaking; blindly increasing bias can worsen leaks. Fog range and detail distribution affect froxel resolution, and FogVolume disappearance against sky requires checking sky-affect state. Visual/HDR results remain untested.

PopupMenu is a Window/Viewport popup and remains invisible until popup methods run. Maximum size controls scrolling; native menu use must be queried with is_native_menu rather than inferred from prefer_native_menu, because linked menus may use native UI regardless.

IDs and indices are different contracts: item setters use indices, move/remove shifts indices and preserves IDs, while signals report IDs or indices. Negative/overflow IDs cause id_pressed to fall back to index; the prose 32-bit range exponent is wrong, so use verified signed 32-bit bounds and stable nonnegative IDs.
Checkbox/radio/multistate items do not update automatically. Implement state transitions and radio exclusivity, then set display state; hiding-on-selection settings differ by item type.
Shortcuts can activate closed menus, with global-only and echo behavior controlled separately. MenuButton may already call activate_item_by_event, so avoid double activation in custom forwarding.

Prefer node-based submenu APIs and enforce child-or-unparented ownership. clear(free_submenus=true) frees submenu nodes; keep external references and lifecycle expectations consistent. Only one popup can bind each special system menu.

Search bar filtering overrides incremental allow_search and minimum item count excludes separators; fuzzy matching is configurable. Test focus, filtered navigation, disabled items, localization and RTL icons separately from pointer activation.

Item icon width limits stack with theme limits and preserve aspect; typography outlines require sufficient MSDF range. Native menu appearance and input behavior need target-OS validation and are not proven by a headless test.

Document aliases such as vec_type/gsampler2D are explanatory placeholders, not shader keywords. Use concrete matching overload types and compile the chosen renderer/stage rather than copying pseudocode or assuming every GLSL overload exists.

Guard math domains: acos/asin inputs within [-1,1], positive log/inversesqrt arguments, nonnegative sqrt, valid pow base/exponent and ordered smoothstep edges. atan(y,x) preserves quadrants unlike atan(y/x); finite-value diagnostics help isolate propagation of invalid inputs.

round half ties are implementation-dependent while roundEven specifies ties-to-even. fract uses floor and mod uses floor division, distinct from truncation-based signed remainder. mix with a boolean selects components while numeric mix interpolates/extrapolates.

Normalize reflect/refract normals and incident vectors as needed; handle zero vectors and total internal reflection explicitly. inverse of singular/poorly-conditioned matrices is undefined, and matrixCompMult differs from ordinary matrix multiplication.

Texture sampling uses normalized coordinates, texelFetch uses integer texels and explicit LOD, and textureGrad uses supplied gradients. Derivative/queryLOD operations are fragment-only; nonuniform flow or nested derivatives can be undefined, and fine/coarse derivatives exclude Compatibility.

Texture signature tables contain likely errors: textureQueryLod array return type differs between summary and detail, samplerCubeArray textureSize omits layer dimension, and 3D textureGrad lists vec2 gradients. The broad textureSize full-texture-read performance claim requires actual backend/source measurement.

Packing quantizes/clamps normalized values and orders low/high bits; unpacking is not exact original-float recovery. unpackSnorm2x16 formula has 32727 instead of 32767, and 4x8 packing prose incorrectly says 16-bit components. Use known-vector round-trip assertions.

bitfieldExtract signed/unsigned extension descriptions are reversed and the unsigned prose uses undefined base; bitfieldInsert range says offset+bits+1 instead of offset+bits-1 and duplicates an extract signature. Bounds must stay within 32 bits.

ldexp exponent is incorrectly marked out while frexp uses out; frexp signed significand range needs negative-input verification. findMSB negative integers searches leading zero bits, unlike positive/unsigned behavior, and zero/all-one cases return -1. Preserve low-frequency APIs as an index and verify actual calls before recipes.

Separate native and embedded Window capabilities; runtime close_requested needs explicit hide or freeing. Popup auto-close prose conflicts with request-only descriptions, so verify lifecycle rather than assume destruction.

HDR request is not effective output: enable HDR 2D on the main viewport and each SubViewport when needed, inspect actual driver after fallback, and react to output headroom changes. Guard zero RGB during normalization and preserve alpha; do not multiply already lit and tone-mapped scene colors indiscriminately.

Content scaling distinguishes virtual content size from physical window size and canvas-item resolution from viewport rendering; integer scaling reduces fractional pixel jitter. Theme decoration applies to embedded windows, while native decorations follow the operating system.

Transient exclusive modal windows block parent input; popup_exclusive requires an unparented window, and auto-unparented orphan windows still need lifecycle cleanup. Restore positions with screen existence and safe clamping, distinguishing desktop coordinates from embedded viewport coordinates.

Platform flags are conditional: popup changes require a hidden window; transparent output needs compositor support and transparent viewport settings. Mouse passthrough polygons define accepted regions and copied arrays need reassignment. Capture exclusion is best effort and Wayland exclusive fullscreen does not add a resolution-mode switch.

The page contains cross-description discrepancies for unfocusable mouse interaction and X11 minimize/maximize disabling. DPI-change and file-drop signal support varies by native backend; HDR, native decorations, multimonitor behavior and capture exclusion require actual environment validation.

Theme bulk-update begin/end calls suppress repeated notifications; child minimum-size caches require child_controls_changed when manually affected. Window input coordinates refer to the embedding viewport, so input handling must use the actual host coordinate space.

Server-created spaces, shapes, bodies, areas and joints are independent of scene nodes and require explicit RID ownership and free_rid cleanup. Removing or clearing shapes only detaches them, and later shape indices shift after removal.

Low-level areas default to non-monitorable, collision layer/mask 1. Register five-argument monitor callbacks and count shape-pair transitions to derive first-entry and last-exit for an entire object; attach instance IDs only when object lookup is required.

Force belongs on physics ticks, impulse on one-time impacts, and constant forces persist until explicitly cleared. Positioned force offsets are in global coordinates relative to the body origin, while one-way collision directions are shape-local.

body_set_state applies next physics frame; force integration callbacks precede standard integration and have a second parameter only with non-null userdata. Omitting standard integration transfers force, torque and damping velocity updates to the custom implementation. State synchronization callbacks only run when previously active.

Validate exact shape payloads: rectangle half-extents, capsule height then radius, segment Rect2 whose size is an endpoint rather than an extent, separation-ray dictionary, and concave segment pairs. Convex server payloads require counterclockwise convex points but are not validated for convexity.

Contacts must be explicitly enabled with a positive reporting cap; a motion test predicts collisions without moving the body. Null direct state and empty space RIDs are meaningful lifecycle conditions. CCD ray and shape casting trade cost against precision, and solver iteration gains must be measured rather than presumed.

Area gravity/damping overrides compose by priority and stop/continue modes; point unit distance zero disables inverse-square falloff. Custom center of mass and inertia affect recalculation on mass/space changes; reset_mass_properties restores shape-derived values. Joint bias and maximum force/bias applicability differ by joint type in Godot Physics.

This is a GDExtension custom PhysicsServer3D implementation interface: overrides replace internal server methods. It is not a collection of ordinary game-controller callbacks and implementing an entire backend is outside normal game-development recipes.

The documented virtual surface marks all backend hooks required, spanning RID creation/freeing, shapes, spaces, body and area state, joints, soft bodies, synchronization, stepping and query flushing. Do not advertise a usable backend from a minimal registration example.

Every method description on this pinned page is missing, including _init/_finish/_sync/_end_sync/_flush_queries/_is_flushing_queries and motion exclusion helpers. Names and signatures alone do not establish scheduling, thread-safety or lifetime contracts; version-matched bindings and existing backend source are necessary before implementation.

_body_test_motion exposes a native PhysicsServer3DExtensionMotionResult pointer plus recovery/separation-ray options, while soft-body rendering uses PhysicsServer3DRenderingServerHandler. These are native integration boundaries that need actual ABI-compatible compilation and behavior tests, not speculative GDScript wrappers.
Record the full page as read and mapped to the extension/physics boundary, but custom backend execution remains untested and no invented per-method tutorials are justified by the incomplete prose.

Initialize with explicit lifecycle order: parent enter before children, children ready before parent, and children exit before parent. Ready normally runs once; request_ready schedules only that node for its next tree entry, so reusable components need deliberate reconnection and teardown behavior.

Parenting governs recursive deletion while owner governs PackedScene persistence. Editor-created children require add_child then scene-root owner; removal may clear ownership, reparent preserves only still-valid ownership, and replace_by leaves the old node orphaned rather than freeing it.

queue_free waits until deferred calls finish and invalidates descendants; remove_child does not delete. Debug-only orphan IDs and tree dumps aid leak diagnosis, but empty release-build orphan reports are not proof of cleanup.

Processing uses separate idle and physics priorities, lower values first, then tree order; set_process changes only idle callbacks. Pause modes and internal processing are separate, and disabling built-in internal processing can break functionality. Logical deltas are scaled/capped and differ from wall time; benchmark with monotonic Time ticks.

Sub-thread groups include inheriting descendants and restrict access outside the group. Communicate with deferred or thread-safe calls, configure which phase handles messages, and order producer/consumer groups; thread-safe calls can become deferred, so do not assume immediate results.

Input order permits GUI interception before shortcut, unhandled-key and unhandled-input gameplay callbacks. Explicitly consume handled events; orphan nodes do not receive normal input/process callbacks. Accessibility element references become invalid after invalidation notifications.

RPC routing requires identical node paths and names, explicit configuration and a connected client. Authority defaults to server ID 1, changes do not replicate automatically, and newly added children do not inherit previous recursive authority assignments. Renaming/moving custom MultiplayerAPI roots requires manual path updates.

Duplication defaults to storage properties, persistent signals, scripts and groups; internal nodes are excluded, required script constructor arguments can drop scripts, and DUPLICATE_INTERNAL_STATE is necessary for nonserialized variables. Cache costly find searches; unique names resolve within ownership scope and can conflict.

Reset physics interpolation after teleports or large reparent transforms. Control reparent keeps only position. Translation notifications can precede child readiness; guard readiness. Native notification support varies, including iOS pause time constraints; Node DPI prose says macOS only while Window includes Wayland, requiring actual backend verification.

Official examples contain duplicate local variable names in get_child and invalid mixed GDScript/C# syntax in get_node_and_resource; rpc_config annotation prose also omits valid quoted mode syntax. Validate runnable examples against bindings instead of copying these snippets.

Distinguish export_project_only Xcode-project generation from archive/IPA building. Debug and release have separate distribution, signing identity and provisioning fields; documented environment overrides allow build-pipeline provisioning without editing presets. Actual Xcode signing and device installation remain untested here.

Export cleanup can unconditionally delete the existing named export directory and Xcode project; use an isolated verified destination and preserve user edits. Validate reverse-DNS bundle identifiers, minimum iOS version and separate visible version/build values rather than treating all version strings interchangeably.

Hardware requirement capabilities narrow the installable device set: A12 and gaming-tier A17 Pro requirements must follow actual features and target coverage. Shader baking supports Forward+/Mobile and is disabled for dedicated servers; a successful project export does not demonstrate runtime renderer support.

Privacy collected-data options independently declare collection, purpose, identity linkage and tracking across data categories. Required-reason API bitfields, tracking domains and camera/microphone/photo-library localized permission descriptions require real app/plugin behavior review and current Apple definitions; this page does not define numeric reason mappings.

Entitlements are distinct from required device capabilities and permission descriptions. Increased-memory-limit is a hint rather than guaranteed memory, camera module inclusion does not grant permission, and exported Info.plist/entitlements XML must be inspected for actual requested features.

Base, App Store, per-size, dark and tinted icons have separate slots and fallbacks; generate and inspect exported icon assets and 2x/3x launch screen layout. Files/iTunes sharing makes the Documents directory accessible, so save-data layout and exposure require intentional configuration. PackedStringArray capability/tracking properties are copies and must be reassigned after edits.

Prefer Font, TextLine and TextParagraph for normal UI; obtain the active abstract TextServer from TextServerManager only for justified low-level needs. Font/shaped-text RIDs require free_rid, and linked variations reuse data and glyph cache rather than independently owning identical atlases.

Feature checks are mandatory: unsupported BiDi/vertical layout ignore requested direction/orientation, security checks return benign-looking false/-1 when unsupported, and complex break iterators can require external support data loaded before other TextServer calls. A false spoof result is not validation when security support is absent.
