Measure cache entries with font_get_size_cache_info including oversampling, glyph count, texture count and texture bytes. Clearing glyphs does not remove textures and clearing textures does not remove glyph metadata; cache maintenance must handle both consistently. Texture access and drawing can trigger pending cache uploads.

MSDF avoids rasterization on font-size changes but loses hinting and may fail overlapping outlines; small-size readability needs visual checks. LCD antialiasing is for horizontal unscaled 2D text, subpixel positioning can rasterize two or four variants, and normal hinting changes monospace metrics. Global oversampling methods are deprecated no-ops; use viewport/font/draw overrides deliberately.

Font weight/stretch/style fields describe matching rather than changing rendered outlines. Use actual faces, variation axes, embolden or transforms. Language/script support overrides do not manufacture missing glyphs; codepoints, glyph indices, composite characters and visual glyph order are separate.

Preserve composite character boundaries in editing/typewriter UI and use shaped hit testing for caret placement. Visual run/glyph ordering differs from logical source order; structured BiDi ranges must cover the complete source without overlap. Shaping-before/after visibility changes layout size and line breaking.

Draw shaped text at a baseline rather than its top edge; ascent/descent may exceed font metrics because of displaced glyphs. Inline object keys must be unique, clipping offsets follow the layout axis, line break arrays contain source character ranges, and arbitrary wrap/justification/ellipsis choices require multilingual visual verification.

Locale-aware case conversion and diacritic stripping can change string length, so do not retain stale character indices. Number conversion and percent signs move to TranslationServer; support-data export and font licensing metadata should be handled explicitly. Low-frequency APIs remain indexed, with actual multilingual visual and native extension behavior untested.

Use full category paths and get_setting_with_override for effective feature-tag values; plain get_setting ignores overrides. override.cfg and the configured override file coexist, and base feature overrides can supersede untagged override values. User preferences belong in checked ConfigFile storage rather than assumptions that changing ProjectSettings immediately changes engine state.

Separate startup-only settings from runtime setters: Engine.max_fps, physics tick/step limits, SceneTree interpolation, Window HDR/resizability/content scaling, DisplayServer VSync, ThemeDB fallback scale and RenderingServer viewport/effect methods. set_restart_if_changed only labels an editor hint; settings_changed is coalesced per process frame and changed settings clear on successful save.

Register custom settings before assigning initial values and property hints. Default-valued settings are not saved, so provide runtime defaults; save/save_custom return Error and require readback. save_custom supports override.cfg for exports. clear(name) prose wrongly claims whole-configuration clearing and the C# custom-property sample uses different setting keys, requiring source verification.

Changing project name changes the user data path unless deliberately stabilized, so rename workflows need save migration and recovery. Custom user directories apply to desktops. Resource text conversion changes exported file extensions: use ResourceLoader for resources; globalize_path res paths cannot represent packaged files as ordinary OS paths, and external files next to the executable need explicit separate paths.

Log collection can drop debugger output past character/error/warning/queue limits; zero observed messages is not proof of no failure. stdout flushing has throughput costs and release differences, --log-file disables rotation, and release stack/local tracking has memory overhead. GDScript warning directory rules use most-specific paths and default excludes addons; selectively include owned addons without breaking third-party warning policies.

Audio driver, actual input/output mix rates and output latency must be queried; requested latency is constrained and ignored on Android, input permission denial can produce silence, and Dummy disables real audio. Web Sample playback trades lower latency for unsupported AudioEffects; silent buses auto-disable effects. Real device playback, recording and latency remain untested.

Accessibility inspector tools require Always Active because they do not activate Auto assistive mode. Keep built-in ui actions while changing their events; GUI focus indications, dialog button order and native dialogs have separate conventions. Default-font settings do not affect imported custom fonts, and oversampling must be configured per additional viewport.

Localization testing should use editor feature overrides to avoid forcing exported locale. Include optional text-server data for dictionary breaking in relevant scripts, check actual text-driver capabilities, and preserve placeholders during pseudo-localization. Runtime pseudolocalization uses TranslationServer; forced RTL is a testing setting.

High-DPI support, content scaling and physical window overrides are separate. Integer stretch can clip windows below the base resolution, so set minimum size. New 4.7 project canvas_items/expand defaults differ from class defaults disabled/keep. Initial-position prose lists Other Screen Center as 3 but initial_screen says 2; use binding enums and actual exported-window tests.

Requested HDR output is startup configuration and runtime toggles use Window.hdr_output_requested. Native Window::_update_viewport_for_hdr_output (Godot 4.7.2 source scene/main/window.cpp:1980) directly sets the RenderingServer HDR 2D buffer for that Window when the stored Viewport.use_hdr_2d is false; it does not necessarily change the Viewport getter. Configure other SubViewports explicitly. The getter is not proof of HDR output success: inspect requested/supported/effective display state and actual renderer/driver, then visually validate the HDR chain. Transparency needs all allowed/window/viewport conditions; native/embedded and multimonitor acceptance remains environment-dependent.

Renderer and driver project values are requests: query RenderingServer current method/driver after command-line overrides and fallback. Base driver settings are superseded by platform-specific overrides. New 4.6 Windows projects select D3D12 despite Vulkan class defaults; Apple Silicon Metal and Intel MoltenVK differ. ANGLE fallback prose conflicts between macOS driver entries and Windows-only fallback notes.

Benchmark controlled cold/warm pipelines separately: disabling engine pipeline cache does not disable GPU-driver caches. Staging limits can stall the GPU; render thread model is experimental with particle/resize crash warnings. Occlusion culling adds CPU work and poorly benefits open scenes, Web defaults exclude it, and CPU ray-buffer resolution changes with logical-core count.

Investigate missing objects before increasing limits: Compatibility item command limits drop draws, OpenGL element limits count surfaces, light limits drop lights, Forward+ clustered-element limits drop lights/decals/probes. Batch buffer capacities and uniform caches have different semantics. Uniform-buffer-size prose describes slot counts despite a buffer_size name and requires exact binding/source checks.

Choose antialiasing by artifact and backend: MSAA only addresses polygon coverage, screen AA can blur, TAA has temporal ghosting, roughness limiting reduces specular aliasing, and mipmap bias combines with resolution/TAA/FXAA offsets. Runtime effect setters and per-viewport behavior differ; do not infer visual quality from successful headless initialization.

Measure depth prepass on real overdraw and backend: Forward+/Compatibility support it, Mobile does not, vendor disabling can alter applicability. GI half resolution excludes LightmapGI; SDFGI convergence uses rendered frames, shadow 16-bit depth trades precision, froxel quality trades cost, and physical light units require bake-time CameraAttributes for LightmapGI/VoxelGI. Excess lightmap batch sizes can cause driver resets.

Navigation defaults affect default world maps, async map/region synchronization adds delay, pathfinding thread count adds copies/memory and synchronization, and crash-prevention checks should remain enabled. Named navigation/physics/render/avoidance layers are independent namespaces with 32 versus 20 layer counts; names do not change bitmask routing.

Choose explicit physics backend when stability across upgrades matters: DEFAULT remains GodotPhysics3D in this prose while newly created 4.6 projects select Jolt. Godot-only solver/sleep settings do not tune Jolt; 2D sleep/penetration notes erroneously refer to GodotPhysics3D/Jolt. Separate-thread physics restricts API access and Jolt loses node context in errors.

Jolt body/pair/contact caps can produce undefined behavior or ignored collisions; world boundaries are finite and excessive speculative contacts create ghost collisions. Internal edge removal only joins edges within one body, ray face indices require an opt-in memory cost, all kinematic contacts can be expensive, and at least two velocity iterations are required for friction. Fix geometry and capacity evidence before arbitrary solver tuning.

Physics tick rate changes CPU cost and damping feel; excessive ticks beyond per-frame step limits slow simulation despite using delta. Interpolation disables jitter-fix and needs transforms updated in physics ticks with reset after teleports. Android agile input flushing and Swappy can alter latency/frame-rate behavior; test target devices instead of treating presets as guarantees.

Texture compression host formats are imported even when override toggles are false; changing target format overrides requires actual reimport. GPU compression supports only stated BC formats with RenderingDevice drivers; cache improves repeat imports at memory cost. Perform any cache cleanup only in verified task-owned paths. VRS images require lossless exact-color data and supported rate/backend checks.

Movie capture uses fixed logical FPS and audio mix rate divisible by FPS; AVI has 4GB and transparency limits, PNG/WAV output is large and PNG capture still lacks transparency. Capture output is not real-time benchmark or HDR certification. C# multi-project layouts keep project.godot and its csproj together; external Blender/FBX2glTF/OIDN tools need actual availability checks.

OpenXR switches request optional runtime capabilities rather than guarantee them: persistent anchors depend on spatial entities/anchors/persistence; built-in discovery can be disabled only when replacing it explicitly. Foveation conflicts with non-Android MSAA and subsampled images with screen effects, frame synthesis must not combine with ASW, and hardware/toolchain-dependent XR remains untested.

EditorSettings is project-independent, automatically saved editor configuration obtained from EditorInterface, not instantiated directly. Project metadata is per-project but stored outside the project and not version-controlled; separate shareable project behavior from user-local plugin preferences.

Remote scene-tree/Inspector refresh, native-call collection and profiler function caps affect observation: collection adds overhead and capped functions disappear entirely. Benchmark exported runs separately and document remote refresh/native profiler conditions; increased remote selection can make changes unreliable.

Respect user-local settings and follow online/network_mode preferences for plugin HTTP work. System proxies are not inherited automatically, debugger ports can advance when occupied, smart symbol resolve can produce rename false positives, and typed projects should verify context rather than trust name-only resolution.

Keep plugin redraw event-driven; update_continuously increases CPU/GPU usage and disables low-processor sleeps. Spinner diagnostics are disabled by debug-canvas-item-redraw to avoid self-induced redraws. Native multiple windows and embedding must use is_multi_window_enabled, not raw settings alone.

Safe-save backup/rename can conflict with antivirus locking on Windows; large text resources often contain binary payloads better split into external binary resources while retaining text scene diffs. Save-before-run disabled means unsaved edits are not executed, and external script reload still prompts on conflicts rather than guaranteeing overwrite.

Blender executable/project toggle/RPC reuse and FBX2glTF/OIDN paths are distinct host requirements. SCP is not SFTP. Verify external tool availability and actual conversion output; editor navigation, grid/gizmo and preview preferences are not runtime game settings.

Animation editor autorename/reset-track defaults and scene-local step/FPS state do not guarantee resource persistence. Validate animation save/readback after node rename or reparent; negative polygon auto-bake delay disables automatic rebakes and can leave stale navigation data.

Custom shortcut paths organize categories, update an existing path, and persist only changed defaults; re-add initially empty shortcuts on plugin setup without replacing user edits. Changed-settings lists clear after autosave; initial values with update_current true reset preferences.

Accessibility test tools require Always Active; imported custom editor fonts need real outline/MSDF/small-size review. No-focus/native dialogs, VSync, font hinting and window embedding have platform restrictions. The single_window_mode description claims inversion relative to embed_subwindows despite both descriptions using true for embedding; verify effective APIs.

Prose has unit and sample errors: editor near/far distances say degrees, C# property hints mismatch property_name/propertyName, and introductory C# Value is undefined. Low-frequency styling properties remain indexed without invented tasks; visual behavior and host tooling were not tested by this read.

Choose anchors/offsets for unconstrained controls and size flags/stretch ratios under Containers; parent containers own direct-child offsets and size. Maximum size takes precedence over minimum size, so bounded minimum size differs from combined minimum size; custom sizing caches require update methods when calculated content changes.

Separate visual placement from input: offset_transform_visual_only defaults true, so animated visuals can move while hit regions stay at original positions. CanvasItem z_index changes drawing rather than mouse-enter delivery; clipping, obstruction, recursive mouse overrides and top-level boundaries determine event propagation.

STOP marks mouse events handled, PASS bubbles through eligible ancestors, IGNORE neither receives nor blocks them. Scroll events pass by default even with STOP; disable root scroll forwarding when gameplay must not receive wheel input. accept_event changes event propagation but does not suppress Input singleton state polling.

Keyboard/gamepad focus needs eligible focus modes and recursive overrides, explicit directional/Tab neighbors, and focus restoration after modals or hiding. Deferred grab_focus is more reliable during ready; hidden visual focus is distinct from actual focus and accessibility-only focus depends on screen reader activation. Introductory claims about only focused nodes receiving all events are overbroad for mouse input.

Theme lookup prioritizes local overrides then nearest themes with variation/base/class fallbacks, then project/default themes. Theme items are not Object properties. Duplicate shared StyleBox resources before per-control changes and pair bulk override updates; validate actual resolved properties and saved resource readback.

Theme notifications may arrive on tree entry before children ready and are deferred while outside the tree. Use readiness guards; custom tooltips need fresh visible Control instances and are freed automatically. Tooltip translation is not automatic for custom implementations. C# scene-tooltip sample returns Node where Control is required and needs a typed instance/cast.

Drag validation should inspect data without mutating it, commit in drop, and handle Vector2.INF positions for keyboard/accessibility dragging using current selection. Drag previews must be outside the tree and are automatically freed; do not retain them after drag end. Check actual drag success on drag-end notification.

UI scaling should follow viewport stretch rather than independent Control scaling; Container child scale resets on instantiation, normal raster font oversampling ignores Control scale, and pivot ratios combine with absolute offsets. Global/local rect sizes become unreliable with rotation/skew and pixel snapping; use transforms for screen-position popup placement.

RTL layout depends on valid translation data and text driver; layout direction and text writing direction are distinct. Numeral conversion prose still cites deprecated TextServer.format_number while that reference directs users to TranslationServer. Preserve accessible name/descriptive relations and test mouse, keyboard, gamepad, touch and screen-reader behavior separately.

GDExtension custom PhysicsServer2D overrides replace internal methods and the documented virtual surface is required. Most methods delegate their contract to the PhysicsServer2D page; preserve RID ownership, shape payloads, forces/impulses and monitor semantics rather than inventing a game-script backend from registration alone.

Lifecycle spans init/finalization, sync/end_sync, query flushing before step and state-sync callbacks before simulation. Synchronization prose says states cannot be accessed while synchronizing on a separate thread and end_sync permits access; verify exact pinned source ordering/thread ownership before backend work.

Motion testing unpacks Transform2D/motion/margin/recovery arguments and writes a native result pointer. Collision hooks include void output arrays and int32 result counts, so ABI matching, bounded output capacity and real native behavior tests are prerequisites.

Pickable area/body hooks correspond to CollisionObject2D input picking; canvas and object IDs are distinct. Contact-debug capture is capped and debug-build-only, while contact-depth-threshold hooks are currently unused by the default implementation. No debug contacts in release is not proof of no collision.

Motion exclusions separately identify RID bodies and object instance IDs; do not confuse these identities. _body_collide_shape prose calls it internal shape_collide and _shape_set_custom_solver_bias prose names the getter, so map exact signatures against engine bindings. Full custom backend execution remains outside ordinary game-development scope and untested.

Custom drawing emits cached commands only from draw notification, immediate draw signal or _draw; deferred draw connections cannot draw. queue_redraw coalesces calls once per frame and only draws visible items. Keep textures/meshes/styleboxes in persistent references because command execution outlives local GDScript variables.

CanvasItem transform/modulation chains stop at non-CanvasItem parents or top_level; self_modulate affects only this node, material inheritance is explicit, and Y sorting groups non-sorted descendants at the parent Y only within equal Z. Z changes rendering order, not input or process priority.

Visibility in tree excludes cull masks; parent/child visibility layers do not inherit and must both match relevant viewport masks. The visibility_layer example asserts no visibility with mask1 or2 despite its broader per-ancestor condition, so test separated ancestor/child layer matches and combined masks instead of assuming its prose.

Do not nest clipping CanvasItems or put them under CanvasGroup; alpha mask clipping differs from Control rectangle clipping. Filter/repeat choices depend on asset scale and imported mipmaps; TextureRect uses its own repeat mechanism and anisotropy rarely helps ordinary 2D.

Batch disconnected lines in multiline and connected gradients in polyline; negative widths use thin primitives that remain thin under scale and some antialiasing requires positive width. Pre-triangulate repeatedly drawn large polygons and use meshes only after measuring redraw costs; animation slices can retain commands without rebuilding each frame.

Coordinate conversions distinguish canvas, viewport, embedder and global desktop; use screen transforms for native popup placement and local events for hit testing. force_update_transform fails outside the tree and is only for up-to-date needs; normal transforms accumulate for efficiency.

Single-line text positions are baseline-based while multiline drawing prose says top-left; match actual output rather than treating origins interchangeably. MSDF pixel_range must match generation, LCD textures use specialized blending, and scale-aware oversampling is a new CanvasItem option despite old draw/Control prose claiming scale ignored.

Per-instance shader parameters require instance uniform declarations, exact case and node setter; ShaderMaterial setters change shared material instances. Visual clipping, layers, scaling, input and font output need runtime/visual acceptance, not only API parse success.

Select prebuilt custom APK templates only without Gradle; Gradle uses source ZIP/build directory and is necessary for the documented custom native themes, Wear swipe dismissal and animated splash XML. APK/AAB, minimum API, target API and architecture binaries are separate choices; verify actual Android toolchain and final manifest rather than infer compatibility from an export preset.

Debug/release keystores use separate path/user/password fields with documented environment overrides and conditional debug fallbacks. Preserve signing continuity and avoid exposing secrets in logs. Package identifier changes create a separate installation/data path and cannot update an existing package; machine version code must increase while visible version name is separate.

Manifest permission toggles do not establish actual grants or ordinary-app eligibility: many listed permissions are privileged, service binding or deprecated. Include only task-required features, inspect merged manifest, and use current Android official API guidance for runtime permission flows; microphone, notification and media permissions need target-device denial/recovery tests.

Custom permission PackedStringArray returns a copy and needs reassignment. Storage APIs vary by media/user-selected/scoped-storage permissions; broad management permissions are not a default save-system recipe. App backup participation and retain-on-uninstall are distinct from guaranteed save preservation.

Native-library compression reduces package size but requires extraction and can slow startup. Shader baking supports Forward+/Mobile and is disabled for dedicated server. OpenGL debug contexts add validation/logging overhead, so benchmark release-equivalent conditions. Native extension binaries must match each selected ABI.

Edge-to-edge content must use safe areas/cutouts; immersive visibility, screen sizes, adaptive foreground/background/monochrome icons and OS/Godot splashes have separate behavior. Wear-specific swipe-dismiss should remain disabled for standard apps unless intended. Splash-background Color prose falls back to an icon-path property, a type mismatch requiring source/generated-output verification.

This read does not validate SDK target policy, signing, AAB packaging, device installation, audio permission or XR hardware. Those require actual toolchain/artifact/device checks; do not mark the large permission index as proof of executable privileged platform capabilities.

Distinguish emission-time random minimum/maximum values from lifetime curves and the draw material. Color/alpha curves multiply vertex colors and require vertex_color_use_as_albedo or explicit COLOR shader consumption; invisible color changes are not necessarily a simulation fault.

GPU particle collisions use dedicated GPUParticlesCollision3D or 2D LightOccluder2D, not ordinary physics bodies. Three-dimensional collisions and attractors act only inside visibility_aabb, so disappearing interactions need bounds and collider-type checks before friction/bounce tuning.

Animated directional/orbital/radial velocity bypass damping; use velocity_limit_curve for caps. Linear damping and damping_as_friction differ, orbit speed counts full rotations per second while angular/orientation properties use degrees. Separate these units from node rotation radians.

Emission point/normal/color textures must share point indexing and point count; normals apply to directed-point shape, box extents are half-size, ring height/radii/cone angle shape emission geometry, and offset/scale are local. emission_shape_changed is editor-only, so runtime logic must not depend on that signal.

Subemission can occur at start/end/collision or constant intervals. Capacity belongs to the subemitter amount and lifetime; exhausted slots prevent new emissions. frequency prose actually describes seconds between emissions and its capacity comparison repeats incompatible count language; verify exact behavior.

Emitter-scale inheritance does not affect particles already in local coordinates; 3D rotation/velocity/per-axis scale require their enable toggles. Turbulence has substantial GPU cost and vector-field attraction is an alternative for shared world-space flows; benchmark fixed particle count/lifetime/bounds and verify quality on target hardware.

Particle lifetime randomness only shortens from the specified base lifetime; scale over velocity uses a velocity range and CurveXYZTexture can provide axis-specific curves. alpha/color appearance, collision/subemitter counts and turbulence remain untested visually and must be checked with real renderer cases.

TreeItem is an Object owned by Tree, not a scene Node; create through Tree/create_child, remove_child detaches without freeing, and explicit free deletes when no longer needed. Maintain domain-model IDs in metadata rather than treat display hierarchy/selection as durable game state.

Button IDs are signed32-bit and distinct from column-local indices; most button mutators use indices while get_button_color uses ID. Translate IDs through get_button_by_id before index operations and handle -1/black absence sentinels; explicit stable IDs avoid reorder mistakes.

Checkboxes require editable cells, set_checked clears indeterminate and setting indeterminate clears checked. propagate_check processes self then descendants then parents and can emit a per-item signal; suppress or guard feedback loops when updating the model.

Cell modes change supported presentation/editing: icon mode cannot edit text, range can use comma-separated dropdown labels, custom mode is a button without a dropdown and custom drawing needs the Tree custom drawing canvas. Deprecated object/method drawing should move to Callable callbacks.

Visible traversal differs from full depth-first and sibling traversal; hidden parents hide descendants, collapse and visibility are separate, uncollapse_tree reveals ancestor folds and move_before/after cannot move the root. Selection cursor effects depend on multi-select mode.

Per-column language, BiDi, auto-translation, wrapping and trimming affect complex text; multiline-edit mode only changes the editor widget and does not prohibit multiline stored values. Accessible descriptions are separate from tooltip labels. Custom styles overlay background colors and icon-width limits combine with Tree limits; verify real UI and state persistence.

Use interned immutable StringName for repeated API names and comparisons; predeclared ampersand literals avoid repeated conversion. String methods convert to String and return String, so keep text processing in String rather than incur interning/conversion churn. C# requires explicit ToString and appropriate .NET/StringExtensions APIs.

StringName ordering operators compare intern pointers, not lexical Unicode order, so sorted user-facing lists need explicit string/natural comparators. Equal hash32 values are not identity. Concatenation and percent formatting return ordinary String, and empty names are false only in GDScript boolean contexts.

Validate numbers before conversion: to_int ignores unrelated characters and to_float accepts prefixes, while split_floats can turn invalid entries into zero. Preserve parse failures rather than interpreting zero as a valid stored setting. Unicode codepoint length/reverse/replace-char are not grapheme-safe for emoji and combining letters.

format replaces sequentially and inserted placeholders can be replaced again, with dictionary iteration affecting output. Use controlled placeholders/values and context-specific JSON/XML/URI escaping; c_unescape explicitly lacks Unicode escapes, so JSON prose suggesting it for decoding does not cover all JSON Unicode strings.

is_absolute_path recognizes res/user virtual paths as well as OS paths. path_join and simplify_path are string operations, not filesystem containment or symlink validation. Filename/node sanitization can create collisions and reserved-platform constraints still need filesystem checks.

glob question mark excludes periods and empty expressions never match. Prefix/suffix trimming differs from character-set stripping, find/rfind use negative and out-of-range rules, and get_slice avoids full split allocation when a single slice is needed. Choose UTF8 over lossy ASCII and check platform-specific multibyte conversion failure.

URI sample encoding omits the A from colon percent3A and C# decode sample omits semicolons; validate examples rather than copy. Locale-sensitive case conversion and advanced identifier spoof checks belong to TextServer capabilities, while basic identifier syntax checks do not enforce security or normalized human names.

GDScript is its own language: power associates left, integer division truncates, remainder can be negative, assignment is not an expression, and match has stricter numeric type matching than equality. Choose explicit float operands and posmod/fposmod where needed; do not transplant Python/JavaScript assumptions.

Use typed arrays/dictionaries for known contracts, but collection types are invariant and nested typed collections unsupported. Array.assign copies compatible contents instead of aliasing differently typed arrays; collection methods can still return Variant. Packed arrays trade convenience for memory/iteration improvements and builtin properties returning packed copies need reassignment.

Initialization order is type defaults, script initializers, init, exported assignments, onready then ready. onready plus export overwrites loaded values and defaults to an error warning. Complex initializers can mutate a collection before a later initializer erases it, so declare dependencies first and validate exported state after instantiation.

Objects/arrays/dictionaries/packed arrays share references while vectors/scalars have value semantics. Loop-variable reassignment does not update source arrays and lambda local captures freeze assignment values while reference-type mutations remain shared. Explicitly duplicate when independent data is required.

Static state belongs to script classes and can retain resources; tool access to other static scripts needs tool mode. The page warns static_unload currently does not free scripts, so do not claim leak recovery from that annotation without pinned-source and actual lifetime validation.

Abstract contracts and variadic rest parameters require Godot4.5+, abstract classes cannot attach as instantiated node scripts, rest parameter must be last/untyped Array and spread-call syntax is absent; callv passes argument arrays. Native nonvirtual method shadowing is unsafe and forbidden by default warning; extend virtuals/signals/notifications instead.

Object as casts can yield null while builtin casts can convert or error; check cast results before methods. Setters/getters run within same class except initializers and direct access from their actual setter/getter; helper methods called by setters can recurse, so keep validated backing-value updates explicit.

RefCounted lifetime and manual Node/Object freeing differ; child deletion recurses, reference cycles need WeakRef, and freed object validity needs is_instance_valid. Tool scripts can execute destructive editor operations and should gate game logic and cleanup carefully.

Signals support module/UI decoupling with a coordinating parent and bound arguments appended to emitted values; establish exact declared/callback signatures and disconnect lifecycles rather than rely on broad any-count prose. await yields for signals/coroutines, normal expressions return immediately, fire-and-forget has no cancellation state handle, and awaited signal result shape depends on argument count.

Assertions do not evaluate expressions in release, so never put behavior or sole malformed-input validation inside assert. Runtime failure paths need explicit errors and tests in debug and release-equivalent conditions. Raw strings preserve escapes but cannot end with odd backslashes; annotation arguments need compile-time-compatible expressions.

Viewed both embedded images: custom Item class appears in the node creation tree and health_changed shows old_value/new_value in Signals. These confirm editor registration/signature UI only. Null prose saying Variant cannot be null contradicts its own untyped-null initialization; exact type/binding behavior needs checking instead of copying that sentence.

Object references can remain non-null after freeing: validate instance lifetime; Node ownership and RefCounted lifetime require different cleanup decisions. Instance IDs identify the current session, not durable save or network entities.

Attaching a replacement script discards previous script state; script_changed precedes initialization and deferred consumers are needed. Required _init arguments prevent scene instantiation and duplication, so injection must respect those entry points.

Dynamic property hooks and notifications already traverse the inheritance chain. _validate_property changes existing properties, custom property lists need notification and tool execution, and _get/_get_property_list must be thread-safe for engine saving. Validate dynamic indices and ranges independently of Inspector hints.

Deferred calls drain until empty in the same idle cycle, so self-deferred recursion can hang; explicit frame signals are needed for a later-frame boundary. Thread-safe signal connection operations do not make receiver code safe on the emitting thread.

Check duplicate connections and emit errors; deferred and one-shot flags change delivery lifetime. Persistent lambdas are unsupported. C# generated name constants avoid repeated StringName conversion and snake_case mistakes.

Dynamic set has no success result, so verify state by reading back; indexed property paths are not scene node paths. Metadata may contain values that cannot serialize and underscore-prefixed editor metadata is not a secrecy guarantee.

Iterator state should live in the supplied state wrapper to support nested iteration. Release builds skip assertions, so iterator and dynamic-property correctness cannot rely on assert side effects. Manual notification calls do not establish a real scene-tree lifecycle.

Locale identifiers use language_Script_COUNTRY_VARIANT with lower-case language, title-case optional script and upper-case optional country; variants can contain multiple underscore-separated keywords. Normalize user-facing locale selection with engine rules rather than assuming a two-letter country pair.

The supported tables include three-letter languages, legacy aliases, Hans/Hant scripts and regional or historical country aliases. This reference is synchronized with core/string/locales.h; supported identifiers alone do not guarantee translated game content, glyph coverage or shaping support.

Six DOF constraints independently configure three translation and three rotation axes; default enabled zero-width limits constrain motion, and enabling a motor does not remove its applicable limits. Linear motors default to zero force, so velocity targets alone are insufficient.

The axis-specific set_param/get_param and set_flag/get_flag interfaces expose the same property groups; distinguish the angular motor flag from the linear motor flag and explicitly configure force, target velocity and limits before testing.

Spring properties and several methods have no prose descriptions; angular force-limit descriptions mix force and acceleration terminology and angular limits do not specify units here. Verify native bindings and the selected physics backend before promising spring equivalence or copying numeric units into a recipe; this page does not establish Jolt feature support.

This extension interface defines language-runtime integration, debugger stack inspection, code completion, validation, reload and profiling hooks; it is not a shortcut for ordinary gameplay C# or GDScript development. Many required hooks have no documented dictionary schema or ownership contract, requiring pinned source and ABI investigation.

_create_script and _has_named_classes are deprecated because the engine does not call them. _find_function returns -1 for absence; reload behavior including soft reload is implementation-specific and cannot imply preservation of runtime state.

Native pointer profiling outputs need capacity and lifetime handling, while thread-enter/exit hooks require a real language runtime design. Completion parent location uses a bitmask combined with class depth; do not treat all locations as simple sequential enum values. Custom language execution remains outside the promised game-development recipes.

Package explicit fallback fonts for deterministic localization; enabled system fallback can hide missing glyphs on a developer machine. Character codes and font-specific glyph indices are distinct, and language/script support overrides do not manufacture missing glyphs.

Prefer ResourceLoader for imported project fonts; raw load_dynamic_font/load_bitmap_font are for editor or external runtime files and return Error. The C# example uses GetNode without a Control type before theme methods, so use a typed node and verify compilation.

MSDF permits scalable glyph caches but loses hinting, can fail overlapping contours and needs pixel range at least twice the largest outline. Higher source size, subpixel positioning and oversampling increase memory or raster cost; assess small-font readability and cache sizes instead of treating MSDF as universally better.

Glyph and texture cache removal are separate operations; keep references consistent when editing caches. Source bytes, packing data and texture images are copies. Outline advances are not saved, requiring serialization readback. Positive FontFile oversampling overrides viewport settings but not draw-method arguments.

Vector3 normally stores 32-bit components despite GDScript float being 64-bit; double-precision builds are a separate ABI decision. Camera/light forward is -Z while imported-model front is +Z, so character orientation needs an explicit asset convention.

Guard zero and near-zero directions, zero projection axes and non-finite values; normalized near-zero vectors can be inaccurate and projection onto zero produces NaNs. Rotation axes and slide normals must be normalized.

Squared distances avoid square roots for threshold comparisons. move_toward uses a distance step while lerp uses a weight; slerp also interpolates length and becomes lerp for zero inputs. Octahedral encoding requires normalized vectors and is lossy.

Right-multiplying a vector by Basis or Transform3D performs an inverse transform under an orthonormal assumption; scaled/skewed cases need explicit inverse/affine_inverse. Godot bounce matches common reflection APIs, while reflect has a different convention. Vector ordering is lexicographic, not a magnitude comparison.

Theme resources apply through uninterrupted Control descendant chains; global custom theme and local Control overrides are separate lookup scopes. Actual visual acceptance must exercise controls, not only inspect a saved Theme file.

Empty add_type entries are in-memory only and disappear on save; define actual items before testing persistence. get_font/get_font_size can return defaults and has_font/has_font_size also consider theme defaults, so these checks alone do not prove an explicit item was saved.

merge_with modifies the receiver and later themes overwrite previous definitions. Removing base types severs variations; renaming to empty or built-in class names can irreversibly remove variation connections even when the name is restored. Validate the variation graph after modifications.

Type variations can nest and are suggested in the editor only for the project default theme. Invalid font sizes below one unset defaults. clear and rename operations fail for missing items or name collisions; check existence and saved readback rather than relying on fallback values.

Choose access scope and file mode before showing the initially hidden dialog. Web cannot browse the host filesystem; sandboxed Linux/macOS force native dialogs, Android native access only supports filesystem scope, and native current_dir is a hint.

Native dialogs ignore root_subfolder, several visibility settings and internal-control modifications; properties cannot change after showing. Treat folder restriction as UI behavior, not a filesystem authorization boundary, and validate selected paths and file contents in application code.

Provide both extensions and MIME types for portable filters, while Windows and embedded dialogs use extensions only. filename_filter is a user substring search rather than a type filter. Selected option dictionaries contain indices, not labels.

Required internal LineEdit/VBox nodes must not be freed. Shared favorites/recents are main-thread-only and update on visibility changes. Thumbnail callbacks need asynchronous generation without stalling, plus lifetime handling for the returned ImageTexture.

CUSTOMIZATION_HIDDEN_FILES describes favorites in error; use hidden_files_toggle_enabled behavior and native-platform checks. Overwrite warnings do not perform saving or prove success; handle FileAccess errors and readback separately.

Enable core spatial entities and each desired capability plus export permissions; query actual headset support after OpenXR session creation. Built-in trackers usually suffice, while custom contexts are for additional capability or vendor integrations. Images confirm capability switches and XRAnchor3D/StaticBody3D collision/mesh hierarchy.

Trackers expose default poses relative to XROrigin3D. Managers need balanced signal connections, existing-tracker enumeration and cleanup; tracker removal callbacks must not assume XRServer still returns a removed tracker. Keep scene roots XRAnchor3D and validate scenes before instantiation.

Persistent anchor creation requires tracking state before persistence, successful UUID assignment and application-owned UUID-to-scene storage. Unpersist completion precedes removal; do not erase application metadata before confirmed success. The sample made_persistent flag is set before checking support or completion and can prevent recovery. Local persistence is app/user/device scoped and sharing is not supported.

Discovery is asynchronous, updates synchronous, and query result data must be first. Filter callbacks to the owning context and free snapshots, entities and contexts. Capture each future locally, reject stale completion after cancellation or scene exit and guard overlapping initialization; the sample shared discovery_result member can observe a replacement future.

Discovery-only planes clean up IDs absent from successful snapshots; do not delete all entities when query_snapshot fails, as the sample cleanup outside its success branch can do. Optional mesh/polygon/label components need capability checks and mesh offset must apply to both collision and visuals.

Examples contain undefined future instead of future_result, OpenXRFutureResultg typo, missing p_get_uuids argument and invalid bool p_is_discovery GDScript syntax. Marker capability conditions use not is_supported while creating supported configurations, reversing intended checks. Marker IDs/data need allowlist mapping rather than arbitrary asset paths. XR runtime, persistence across sessions and passthrough occlusion remain device-untested.

Library-qualified animation names use library/animation, except the unnamed default library. current_animation is runtime state and is not saved in scenes; autoplay and persisted AnimationLibrary resources are the appropriate save/readback targets.

play updates properties at the next processing pass; advance(0) applies immediately. pause preserves position, stop resets position and custom speed, and is_playing stays true even at zero speed. is_animation_active prose is internally ambiguous about stop, so verify the shown pause/stopped predicate against runtime.

Queued transitions stall behind looping animations; animation_changed covers queued transitions rather than play or AnimationTree changes. seek skips intervening events and does not emit animation_finished at the end; advance is required for completion semantics.

Capture is separate from ordinary blend timing and requires capture tracks; capture duration follows speed_scale rather than custom_speed. Section times and markers require distinct endpoints, with out-of-range values falling back to full bounds.

Use AnimationMixer callback_mode_method, callback_mode_process and root_node instead of deprecated AnimationPlayer accessors. keep_state stop avoids visual reset and does not run method/audio/playback tracks; verify both target property state and saved resources in an isolated test.

Register through EditorPlugin.add_export_plugin and provide a stable unique name; exporters sort plugins by name, so ordering affects combined transformations. Scope behavior by platform/features and balance export-start/end cleanup.

Scene/resource customization requires begin hooks plus implementation and a configuration hash. Script modification alone does not invalidate cached customization; include relevant configuration or implementation revision in the hash and test repeated exports. Returned replacement scenes require disposing the old scene.

_export_file runs before customization; skip excludes that file, while add_file remaps only inside this callback and does not import the provided bytes. Use resource customization for imported resource remapping and retain specified compressed/atlas replacement resources.

Export-option overrides hide user options and replace preset values; inspect effective preset values and warnings. Android dependency/AAR/manifest hooks require Gradle export, relative AAR paths are under res://addons, and binary prebuilt manifests require binary-preserving modification.

Use current Apple embedded platform methods for iOS/visionOS instead of deprecated iOS names. Linking a framework and embedding it are different decisions; exclude system libraries from embedding and keep shared-object directories free of non-code files for signing. Verify exported binaries, platform signing and relocated loading rather than only callback execution.

The agent computes paths and avoidance but does not move its parent. Use global next positions once per active physics frame, stop updates once navigation finishes, and avoid path-query calls inside waypoint signal callbacks to prevent recursive repathing.

Path radius comes from baked NavigationPolygon agent_radius, while NavigationAgent radius affects avoidance only. Separate navigation layers from avoidance masks/layers, use set_navigation_map on the node, and test cross-region connectivity rather than assuming avoidance repairs a disconnected graph.

Use desired velocity and apply velocity_computed safe velocity through the body movement implementation. Teleports require set_velocity_forced once, not every frame. Enable avoidance only where needed and bound neighbor distance/count; max speed and time horizon must match actual actor behavior.

Too small waypoint/target thresholds overshoot into repath loops, while oversized thresholds skip corners and leave the mesh. Search polygon/distance caps and returned path clipping may produce partial endpoints; navigation_finished alone does not prove target_reached. Query metadata keys depend on requested flags.

get_path_length zero can mean still calculating, not an empty successful route. Do not mutate the returned path to drive motion. time_horizon_obstacles defaults to zero while prose says positive, requiring binding/runtime verification before assigning a universal minimum.

Vector4 is a numeric quadruplet with default 32-bit components, not a Quaternion rotation implementation. Its fourth component participates in length, normalization and arithmetic; homogeneous position/direction conventions must be assigned by the caller.

Right multiplication vector * Projection uses the transpose, not the inverse; inverse projection must explicitly use projection.inverse() * vector. Validate perspective conversion and finite/nonzero denominators before reducing homogeneous coordinates.

Component-wise min/max, reciprocal and division are distinct from scalar magnitude decisions. Lexicographic ordering checks X/Y/Z/W and is unsuitable for distance ordering; compare squared distances for thresholds. Near-zero normalization and NaNs need explicit guards and approximate equality is more robust than exact float equality.

This is a custom native physics backend implementation surface, overriding direct-state methods rather than a gameplay RigidBody3D integration script. Nearly every virtual is required and undocumented, so map ordinary gameplay work to PhysicsDirectBodyState3D and reserve this class for source-backed backend integration.

The interface separates transient force/impulse operations, persistent force/torque, local/global center of mass, inertia tensors, contacts and simulation step. Required return shapes alone do not establish units, thread ownership or lifetime; verify base-class contracts and pinned engine bindings.

Contact collider RID, instance ID and Object are distinct outputs; ensure index bounds and object lifetime, and keep local contact positions/normals consistent with the backend conventions. A registered extension or successful library load is not evidence that the backend obeys these contracts; custom backend execution remains untested.

Scene changes immediately remove the outgoing scene, leaving its get_tree and current_scene null until end-of-frame replacement. Check returned Error and await scene_changed from a surviving Autoload before accessing the new initialized scene. SceneTree owns replacement nodes and frees them on later changes; direct current_scene assignment does not modify the hierarchy.

Group calls ignore missing methods or mismatched arguments, so successful execution is not coverage evidence. Unique group delivery requires deferred flag and keeps only first-call arguments; immediate broad group operations can stutter. Group order follows scene hierarchy, not gameplay priority.

SceneTree timers run after node processing, default to continuing during pause, and separately choose physics or real-time behavior. Tree-created tweens are not node-bound and can outlive scene nodes; bind them or use Node.create_tween for automatic cancellation.

Pause stops physics/collision processing and depends on node process modes; process_frame and physics_frame signals occur before callbacks. get_frame counts physics steps, not rendered frames or elapsed time. Debug collision/navigation/path hints are startup/editor diagnostics rather than reliable runtime toggles.

Set custom MultiplayerAPI before spawners/synchronizers enter readiness; nested root-path APIs are disallowed. Disabling automatic polling requires explicit poll placement and thread synchronization. Accessibility supported and enabled are distinct states, and iOS ignores SceneTree.quit.

Custom export platforms inherit this extension and register through EditorPlugin.add_export_platform; initialization and cleanup are tied to registration. Supply required platform identity, binary extensions, features and validation plus real project export implementation.

_export_project can reuse save_pack/save_zip or process exported files itself. PCK/ZIP and patch hooks are distinct; patch lists have already been loaded and provide context, with preset patches used when the list is empty. Test package contents and patch load order.

Export options require name/type dictionaries; the required flag is only a hint to custom configuration validation and does not automatically block export. Implement warnings and _has_valid_export_configuration/_has_valid_project_configuration, using config error/template state only within validation hooks.

One-click deploy must build to a temporary location and upload/run on the selected actual device; menu refresh, device architecture and debugger protocol are separate hooks. Scale icons with editor scale. Successful plugin registration is not evidence that a new platform toolchain, signing or device execution works.

RichTextLabel maintains a tag stack independently of text; assigning text rebuilds and discards manual edits, while append_text avoids full parsing but cannot close tags opened by earlier calls. Use add_text for raw untrusted text and balanced push/pop contexts for explicit formatting; entangled BBCode is unsupported.

Wrapping plus fit_content needs a maximum width through custom_maximum_size or propagated maximum size. Each paragraph has independent BiDi context, while other Unicode break characters can wrap within a paragraph. Text visibility counts codepoints rather than graphemes or C# UTF-16 code units.

Threaded text metrics cover only loaded content until is_finished/finished; drawing-dependent scrolling and visible bounds need an actual draw afterward. is_finished replaces deprecated is_ready. Unloading or hiding controls can prevent draw-based awaits, requiring lifetime-aware validation.

BBCode URL metadata remains String; push_meta can carry typed data and emits no automatic action. Validate URL schemes and application actions before shell_open. Keep image alt text, table/column assistive names and focus visuals for accessibility.

Required internal menu/scrollbar nodes must not be freed. C# examples contain the wrong TextEdit menu enum, implicit enum/int argument issues and BackgroundGPanel typo, so rewrite and compile. Clear claims stack-only behavior and restoration on redraw; verify this against runtime rather than treating clear as persisted text reset.

Paragraph removal may defer cache invalidation only for self-contained content or a completed bulk operation. Image updates use keyed masked fields; highlights can overlap with default padding, and MSDF outlines require sufficient pixel range. Distinguish full-content size from visible-content bounds in layout acceptance.

Use concrete StandardMaterial3D or ORMMaterial3D rather than instantiate the abstract base. Feature toggles gate shader cost; set_flag accepts a single enumerator and must not combine enum values as a bitmask, unlike stencil_flags.

Opaque rendering is cheapest; alpha blending disables shadow casting and incurs sorting, while scissor/hash and alpha depth prepass offer different shadow and depth behavior. Non-Mix blending or disabled depth test forces transparent rendering. Depth draw ALWAYS does not itself add transparent geometry to depth prepass.

Validate texture color encoding before forcing sRGB conversion, especially ViewportTexture; unnecessary conversion darkens albedo. Vertex sRGB conversion is unavailable in Compatibility. Normal/bent-normal mapping and anisotropy need mesh normals/tangents; material anisotropy differs from texture anisotropic filtering.

ORM channels are occlusion R, roughness G and metallic B; separate metallic/roughness textures multiply corresponding scalar strengths. Detail albedo is not modulated by albedo_color. Emission increases visible brightness but requires appropriate GI participation to light other objects, and physical emission intensity uses nits only when physical light units are enabled.

Height/parallax mapping is disabled with triplanar UV1 and deep parallax has significant GPU cost; triplanar uses three texture reads per lookup. Refraction samples opaque screen content and cannot refract other transparent materials. Subsurface scattering is unavailable with transparent-background viewports.

Stencil presets own next_pass and can erase manual changes on edit/reload; use material_overlay for additional passes. Grow outlines need suitable normals to avoid gaps. GPUParticles trails require skinned trail meshes and their material flag breaks ordinary mesh rendering. Particle billboard flipbooks also require positive animation speed.

Billboard keep-scale prose conflicts between FLAG description and property scope, and FIXED_Y axis wording needs source verification. Per-vertex best-for-mobile and clearcoat secondary transparent pass are broad prose claims to verify against the target renderer. z_clip_scale can break screen effects, FOV override assumes perspective KEEP_HEIGHT, and VR billboards need actual headset validation.

Source correction: local Godot 4.7.2 scene/resources/material.cpp:1257-1307 applies FLAG_BILLBOARD_KEEP_SCALE to fixed-Y and particle billboards as well as enabled billboards; the flag enum prose limiting it to BILLBOARD_ENABLED is stale. Fixed-Y generated basis retains the world Y axis, so the enum sentence that X always faces the camera is not a sufficient geometry contract.

NavigationServer2D owns navmesh maps/regions/links and avoidance agents, not AStar2D or AStarGrid2D. Changes synchronize after physics and asynchronous iterations may take longer; use iteration IDs/map changes and actual path outcomes rather than same-frame setter assumptions.

Compatible region edge endpoints must both match within edge margin, with map and region edge connection enabled and matching cell sizes. Links use a separate connection radius. Avoidance ignores navigable regions and cannot guarantee safe physics motion or bridge disconnected areas.

map_force_update is deprecated and unsupported with asynchronous updates; it flushes the global command queue and locks the server, so new recipes should wait for synchronization rather than force updates. Iteration ID zero means unsynchronized and counters wrap to one.

Server mutations are queued for synchronization from threads, but SceneTree source parsing must run on the main thread; mesh GPU readback can stall rendering. Parse into source_geometry_data, then bake asynchronously and wait before reuse. Custom parser callbacks must add source data rather than mutate navigation meshes.

Created RIDs require explicit free_rid cleanup and avoidance callbacks must be cleared/paused during teardown since they continue independently of SceneTree state. Forced velocity resets belong to teleports; constant use can stall agents. Neighbor limits and time horizons trade CPU time against avoidance safety.

region_owns_point means closest-point ownership among map regions rather than polygon containment; equal-distance ties follow registration order and overlapping meshes are ambiguous. Connection indices must be bounded below count despite prose ambiguity. Uniform random points weight surface area; unweighted sampling biases regions/polygons. query_path mutates its supplied result, so give concurrent requests independent results.

Viewport is abstract: create Window or SubViewport and choose shared or independent worlds, active cameras, listeners and actual texture presentation. Editor camera overrides can invalidate cached camera references. SubViewportContainer handles mouse enter/exit and changes input ownership, while custom textured views need coordinate conversion and explicit notification.

push_input accepts embedder or local coordinates and follows input/GUI/shortcut/unhandled processing without Input project remapping. Marking handled stops propagation but does not change Input polling. push_text_input replaces focused Control text rather than simulating typing; focus_changed does not emit on focus loss.

use_hdr_2d produces linear RGBA16 buffers and is separate from display HDR support. Await frame_post_draw before capture, inspect save errors and convert image encoding appropriately; a captured PNG cannot establish display HDR. Transparent background disables SSR, subsurface scattering and depth of field.

Oversampling now has boolean enable and positive override factor, while get_oversampling returns effective factor; scaled font and DPITexture behavior must be distinguished from older references. GUI snapping, transform snapping and vertex snapping affect different stages and trade crispness for smooth camera motion.

Picking has a nondeterministic 64-object candidate limit; sorting afterward cannot guarantee the globally topmost object and first-only requires sorting for top candidates. Canvas cull masks do not imply inherited visibility layers.

3D scaling applies only the 3D buffer; FSR2/MetalFX temporal at native scale still perform temporal AA while spatial modes disable at one. MetalFX requires the active Metal driver, temporal minimum scale needs a device limit, and supersampling falls back to bilinear. MSAA smooths geometry edges but not shader or texture aliasing.

Occlusion culling consumes CPU and needs occluders, usually giving little benefit in open scenes; Web templates omit it by default. Shadow atlas zero removes positional shadows, subdivisions reduce per-light resolution and 16-bit depth trades precision for possible device gains. Benchmark each viewport and distinguish visible/shadow/canvas statistics.

Debug materials replace custom shader displacement in several modes. SSAO debug claims Forward+-only conflict with updated Compatibility SSAO coverage and require source/runtime review. VRS requires supported hardware and exact lossless colors; TAA has particle/skinned artifacts and modifies mipmap bias. GUI/display/XR quality remains environment-untested.

Source audit separates effect support from debug visualization: local Godot 4.7.2 drivers/gles3/rasterizer_scene_gles3.cpp:2988-2997 implements Compatibility SSAO with differently scaled intensity/radius. This does not by itself refute a Forward+-only SSAO debug-buffer mode; avoid conflating availability of the effect and availability of its Viewport debug visualization.

String modifications return copy-on-write values; retain returned erase/replace/strip results. Unicode codepoints differ from graphemes and C# UTF-16 indices, so reverse or single-character replacement can break composed characters. Bounds errors still occur for string indexing, including invalid negative indices.

to_int removes nonnumeric characters and to_float parses only a numeric prefix; zero is ambiguous failure. Validate syntax and finite/range constraints before configuration parsing. is_valid_ip_address includes reserved addresses and proves format rather than connectivity or public reachability.

format performs replacements sequentially and may replace placeholders inserted by earlier values; dictionary order therefore changes results. C# percent formatting is unavailable and interpolation/native formatting must be used. Hash equality cannot establish string identity.

get_slice is efficient for a few fields, but missing slices return empty; split_floats can omit invalid fields and therefore shift data alignment. Use strict schema parsing for fixed-column save/network formats. lstrip/rstrip take character sets rather than literal prefixes or suffixes.

path_join and simplify_path perform textual path operations and do not prove existence, symlink resolution or authorized containment. Filename/node-name sanitization can collide and does not ensure platform-specific reserved-name acceptance. Glob question mark excludes periods and empty matches always fail.

C-unescape excludes Unicode escape sequences, so the JSON-unescape suggestion cannot replace a JSON parser. URI examples have malformed %3 instead of %3A and missing C# semicolons; uri_decode converts plus to space while uri_file_decode preserves plus. ASCII conversion loses unsupported characters; prefer explicit UTF-8 and handle platform-specific encoding failure.

String.num defaults to at most 14 significant digits and trims zeroes, unsuitable for unqualified lossless float serialization. C# Split and numerical formatting need explicit version/culture review; the page claim that Split has no count equivalent is overly broad. Use Unicode-aware identifiers for GDScript and ASCII identifier validation only for interfaces that require it.

Tree has one actual TreeItem root; hide_root only changes presentation. Build items in code and keep durable model IDs separate from transient item references, since clear/free invalidates them. The initial examples create a Tree without adding it to the scene and therefore do not display it.

clear, create_item and column count changes are rejected during mouse selection; defer structural rebuilding outside active callbacks and preserve model/selection state. Validate parent belongs to the same Tree and handle create_item returning null.

In multi-select mode get_selected/get_selected_column describe focus cursor, not necessarily selected cells; iterate get_next_selected and inspect per-cell selection. multi_selected replaces item_selected and item_collapsed fires for expansion too. Keyboard activation and incremental search require focused-control acceptance.

Drop flags control visuals/sections and reset after dropping; set them while _can_drop_data runs and implement actual model reparenting with cycle checks. Sections include child insertion 2 and absent -100, so do not assume only -1/0/1. Button click IDs differ from get_pressed_button index.

Custom drawing canvas clears every Tree redraw and needs redraw-time callbacks, not retained one-off drawing. Column expansion, clipping, minimum widths, shaping language and RTL titles are separate settings; title justify is unsupported. Test focused/selected/hovered/disabled themes and full hierarchy keyboard usability.

TileSet library entries use a source ID, atlas coordinate and alternative ID; source array indices are not source IDs. add_source returns -1 on failure and transfers a source away from another TileSet, so duplicate or deliberately migrate ownership before reuse.

Property layers independently enable collision, navigation, occlusion and typed custom data on atlas tiles. Distinguish layer array indices from 1-based navigation bit numbers and physics masks. Reordering/removing layers updates atlas tiles but external code storing indices needs migration.

Terrain mode chooses matching sides/corners; terrain colors only identify editor categories. Shape, offset axis and layout affect grid indexing, while tile_size is an encompassing pixel rectangle. Isometric sorting needs consistent Y-sort across sibling TileMapLayers and their Node2D parent.

Proxy lookup prioritizes alternative, coordinates then source; missing direct proxy queries return empty arrays or -1, but map_tile_proxy returns original identifiers. Source/coordinate proxies preserve less-specific IDs, so test destination tile validity and saved map migration rather than assume every proxy changes all three identifiers.

Custom data names are unique identifiers; changing names/types requires application schema validation and saved readback. Patterns are resources stored by index, and cleanup_invalid_tile_proxies only removes invalid mappings rather than repairs maps. Verify visual terrain transitions, physics contacts and actual cross-tile navigation as distinct behaviors.

Godot automatically creates/frees accessibility elements for Nodes; ordinary UI should use Node accessibility properties and supported Control semantics. Custom subelements represent non-Node list cells/menu/text runs and are freed with their parent, with early free_element when appropriate.

Roles carry navigation semantics: container is ignored by readers, region is a navigable landmark and text-run is reserved for internal text elements. Choose meaningful roles, labels, descriptions and relationships rather than using role description as a substitute for behavior.

Accessibility actions invoke a one-Variant callback with action-specific payloads, including selection dictionaries, scroll units/hints and typed value changes. Advertise only implemented actions, validate payloads and sync the actual model and accessibility state after execution. Custom actions also require ACTION_CUSTOM dispatch registration.

Bounds are relative to node position; transforms, window rectangles and focus must reflect current layout. Windows already update their own focused/rect state. Selected text offsets are relative to shaped-text subelements rather than the entire widget string; last-line text creation avoids an extra newline.

AccessibilityFlags enum values are ordinal selectors, not combinable bitmask powers. Related radio groups require each member to reference all others. Live polite and assertive announcements differ in interruption priority and should be applied purposefully.

is_supported proves backend support, not active screen-reader processing or usable narration. Verify SceneTree accessibility state and actual keyboard/screen-reader interaction on each target OS; these visual/assistive environment checks remain untested. The reference misspells checked as checekd in its parameter, so use positional arguments or verified binding names.

CPUParticles3D is a CPU simulation alternative for target renderer/device capability, but the same-functionality description must not imply GPU collisions, trails or turbulence parity. Conversion requires GPUParticles3D with ParticleProcessMaterial and actual visual retest for unsupported features.

Particle colors multiply mesh vertex colors and require vertex_color_use_as_albedo or a shader consuming COLOR; alpha fading also needs explicit alpha handling and a suitable transparency mode. Animation frames require particle billboard material and nonzero speed.

One-shot emitting=true does not interrupt an active cycle; restart is the deliberate retrigger and finished occurs only for one-shot completion. Fixed FPS changes update cadence rather than simulation speed, while speed_scale zero pauses. Preprocess can add startup work.

Local coordinates follow emitter/parents while global particles remain behind. Visibility AABB controls activity and clipping; capture_aabb is only the current active-frame bounds, so generate or sample across the full effect and movement range.

Fixed seed plus controlled restart/process timing supports reproducible appearance, not a universal cross-build determinism promise. request_particles_process with zero speed_scale can step emission and residual nonemission time for timeline tests; benchmark CPU costs under fixed amount, lifetime and camera.

Point/color/normal arrays are copied on retrieval and require reassignment; directed emission needs compatible arrays and normalized direction. Scale axis curves require split_scale. Several angle/orbit units are unspecified and randomness is misleadingly described as lifetime randomness, requiring binding verification rather than copied GPU assumptions.

Focus and editing are distinct: arrow-key focus does not edit, Tab/grab_focus still do, and unedit preserves focus. Use editing_toggled plus explicit edit policy for gamepad navigation and keep_editing_on_text_submit for chat-style repeat entry.

Assigning text does not emit text_changed, so programmatic updates must explicitly refresh validation/model state. Placeholder is not a default value. max_length can truncate existing or pasted text and emits rejected substrings; insert_text_at_caret separately claims all-or-nothing overflow and requires a behavior test.

Composite-character caret/backspace settings need grapheme-aware tests with emoji and combining marks; the caret_mid_grapheme note saying backspace always deletes components conflicts with backspace_deletes_composite_character_enabled. Use boundary helper methods rather than C# UTF-16 offsets for Godot columns.

Password mode masks display only and is separate from virtual-keyboard password type; it does not remove plaintext from the control/model. Virtual keyboard type is a platform hint rather than field validation and password type falls back to default on Web. IME apply versus cancel changes whether composition is committed or discarded.

Shortcut disabling does not disable all caret movement, and clipboard actions strip ASCII control characters but are not input schema validation. Linux middle-button paste is platform-specific. Keep focused/read-only visuals, selection and accessible caret usable.

expand_to_text_length grows without shrinking, so text edits need explicit layout acceptance. Internal popup menu must not be freed; C# enum values need correct integer conversion and verified event signatures. get_scroll_offset units and the macOS Cmd+A/Cmd+P shortcut descriptions are suspicious and require pinned binding/runtime checking before recipes.

XRInterfaceExtension is an external XR provider implementation surface rather than ordinary OpenXR game setup. Initialization/capabilities/tracking status, per-view transforms and projection, target dimensions and texture RIDs must form a consistent runtime contract. User settings may override suggested tracker/pose names.

_process updates trackers before game/physics processing, _pre_render commonly synchronizes tracking before rendering and _pre_draw_viewport can suppress rendering for a removed headset. Frame-end work is only called for active submitted interfaces; balance backend resources during uninitialization.

Projection returns PackedFloat64Array without documented element layout here, and raw texture getters have no ownership descriptions, so use pinned native bindings and actual provider validation before implementation. add_blit prose refers to absent _commit_views and needs source verification for legal call phase. VRS texture format must agree with the returned resource. Device rendering, haptics and AR feed behavior remain untested.

TextParagraph wraps TextServer for one paragraph and multiple text/font spans; check add_string/add_object results, give inline objects unique keys and update object size through resize_object before measuring. Object length participates in source offsets as replacement characters.

Draw positions are top-left bounding-box coordinates rather than Font baseline conventions. Positive draw oversampling overrides viewport settings, and line width measures the primary axis according to orientation. Use actual font shaping and wrapped line metrics for layout rather than string length.

hit_test always returns a valid caret offset even outside visible text, so it is not a hit-inside-content predicate. Keep character offsets distinct from glyph indices/graphemes and clamp caller-selected line indices. BiDi override ranges must cover the full source without overlaps.

TextServer RIDs returned for full/line/dropcap buffers are managed through this abstraction and need pinned ownership checks before manual freeing. clear removes text/inline objects and clear_dropcap is a separate operation. Test clipping, ellipsis, negative spacing, RTL/vertical layout and custom inline-object drawing in a rendered environment.

This provides required native overrides of PhysicsDirectBodyState2D for a custom GDExtension physics backend. Ordinary RigidBody2D gameplay integration should use the base direct state provided by the engine rather than instantiate this backend interface.

Unlike 3D, angular velocity, torque and inverse inertia are scalar, while forces/contacts and centers of mass are Vector2 with Transform2D state. Preserve the base-class coordinate, force-versus-impulse and simulation-step contracts; signatures alone do not establish integration correctness.

Every required getter/setter and contact accessor must agree with backend state, contact counts and collider RID/instance/object lifetimes. Collision layer/mask hooks remain undocumented here, needing pinned source binding checks. Custom backend behavior has not been executed and is outside the claimed game-script recipes.

Discovery finds entities having at least one requested component, whereas query_snapshot requires all requested components and first-entry OpenXRSpatialQueryResultData. Optional component filtering can therefore exclude entities from a query; distinguish absent optional data from entity removal.

Context creation/discovery return futures and dropping future references does not cancel operations. Retain per-request futures, inspect successful completion, reject stale callbacks and explicitly free contexts/snapshots during teardown. Updates are synchronous and return snapshots immediately.

make_spatial_entity must use the discovering context; native-created entities require add_spatial_entity registration. Free entity RIDs through their ownership path and avoid double-free when tracker objects already own them. Native runtime handles are for GDExtension capability handlers rather than portable save identifiers.

Check capability and per-component support on actual hardware, then extract snapshot buffers while their snapshot remains valid. UInt32 data appears in PackedInt32Array and may require explicit unsigned interpretation. Persistent UUIDs, not internal entity IDs, correlate saved anchors; runtime tracking/persistence remain device-untested.

Basis stores rotation/scale/shear with script-facing columns, while native C++ operator[] exposes rows; use get_column/set_column for binding-consistent native logic. C# default Basis is zero rather than GDScript identity, so explicitly initialize Basis.Identity.

Do not infer invertibility or rotation suitability from non-null/boolean state: Basis identity is false in GDScript. Guard nonfinite or near-singular determinants, and distinguish orthogonal, conformal and orthonormal requirements. Orthonormalization removes scale/shear and can lose intentional transforms.

Euler operations use radians and intrinsic YXZ by default, while Inspector angles are degrees. Quaternion conversion cannot preserve scale and Basis slerp requires rotation bases. Preserve scale separately for animation and verify negative determinant/reflection handling.

scaled changes rows in parent/global coordinates whereas scaled_local changes columns in self/local coordinates; multiplication order matters for both scaling and flip matrices. looking_at needs nonzero noncollinear direction/up and an explicit camera -Z versus model +Z front convention.

The vector-multiplication example comment claims swapping X/Z while values swap X/Y; C# scale example omits new Vector3 constructor keywords and needs compilation. tdot equivalences and quaternion decomposition assumptions should be pinned to bindings if used in low-level implementations.

EditorExportPlatform performs platform-specific full export or pack/zip operations using compatible templates and presets. export_project notify=false suppresses export-begin plugin participation, so test required customizations and avoid unintentionally bypassing them.

Check Error returns and export message severity; save_pack/save_zip return dictionaries whose result must be checked and so_files separately packaged. Embedded packs append to a supplied binary with offset/size metadata, not a complete platform installer by themselves.

Custom file export callbacks receive raw data and encryption include/exclude filters/key; implement actual encryption semantics deliberately without logging secrets. Progress file_index/count are neither guaranteed unique nor exact and cannot serve as content identity. Native-library callbacks require tag and destination handling.

Empty patch overrides use preset patch lists rather than disabling patches. Include forced core and internal generated files when building custom formats. find_export_template returns path/error and custom platforms may use their own template storage.

Generated debug flags can include file-server passwords, debugger host and breakpoints; sanitize command evidence. SSH/SCP helpers are real remote execution/upload and require the actual task authorization, quoted commands and checked completion rather than being a local export validation shortcut. Target signing, install and device launch remain untested here.

RenderSceneBuffersRD is an engine-owned buffer object for RenderingDevice renderers and must not be instantiated from scripts. Use the provided instance inside a valid rendering callback; buffer existence is guaranteed only during viewport rendering, not across frames or resize. Compatibility is outside this interface.

Internal versus target sizes refer to before and after upscaling; multiview color/depth/velocity textures are arrays and layer indices must respect get_view_count. MSAA getters return the multisampled variant only when enabled, so consumers must check actual texture formats/sample counts.

Named texture creation is cached and returns existing textures even with a newly supplied definition, so reconfiguration requires intentional owned-context invalidation rather than blindly calling create_texture again. clear_context frees all associated buffers; never clear the engine default render_buffers context as routine cleanup.

Views/slices need an existing source and valid layer/mipmap ranges. Separate custom context naming and owned resource lifetimes from engine buffers; verify RenderingDevice usage flags, shader access and synchronization in a rendered isolated case rather than treating RID retrieval as effect validation.
